item.title: Where to Approximate in Neurosymbolic Inference?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Probabilistic neurosymbolic methods rely on weighted model counting (WMC) to combine neural predictors with symbolic constraints. Exact WMC is #P-hard and typically scales poorly, so many methods resort to approximations. By unifying existing approaches under a three-step bottom-up approximate compilation pipeline, we study where approximation budget is best allocated. Inspired by tensor networks, we instantiate two steps with tensor train decompositions and derive new pipelines that exactly multiply approximated factors and recompress their products via SVD- or interpolation-based schemes. Across six tasks in Sudoku, arithmetic reasoning, and scene understanding, and across increasing problem sizes, our pipelines produce WMC estimates orders-of-magnitude more accurate than prior methods. This translates into stronger downstream learning on tasks where reasoning relies on tight interactions between symbolic factors, where cruder approximations ignore these dependencies. Our pipelines open novel design space for effective approximate compilation of challenging probabilistic reasoning tasks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When Covariance Is Not Enough: Kernel-Based Regularization for Single-Cell Counterfactuals
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Counterfactual editing of single cells, predicting how an observed cell would look had one factor been different, enables in-silico screening where experiments are infeasible, but is useful only if the edit is faithful to the individual and not merely to the condition. Concept bottleneck generative models make the effects of interventions interpretable by decomposing a cell's representation into known and unknown factors. Previous work uses a linear cross-covariance penalty to disentangle known and unknown dimensions. We demonstrate that this first-order criterion does not fully separate information when non-linear interactions are present. We first demonstrate the inadequacy of linear cross-factor penalization with simulation experiments with controlled edits and known non-linear covariate effects. We then demonstrate that adding a nonlinear kernel criterion, the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, is able to recover the true intervention effects on simulation data. Finally, we apply the non-linear concept bottleneck model to a complex single-cell RNA-seq dataset and find that it improves the ability to generate counterfactual expression profiles of cells under diff…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: WINIC: An Automatic Cycle-Accurate Multi-Platform Microbenchmarking Tool for Instruction Performance Metrics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Performance models allow developers to gain important insights into the interaction of their code with the hardware that executes it, and enable them to apply target-specific optimizations. To create in-core performance models for out-of-order processors, architecture-specific performance metrics like latency, throughput, and port binding of individual instructions are indispensable. For x86 microarchitectures, there already exist tools to automatically obtain those values; however, the extension of performance modeling tools like the Open Source Architecture Code Analyzer (OSACA) to support further architectures like RISC-V emphasizes the need for a multi-platform microbenchmarking tool. We present WINIC (What I Need Is Cycles), an automatic cross-platform microbenchmarking tool. Unlike previous tools, it can obtain throughput and operand-based latency metrics for most supported instructions of any 64-bit x86, AArch64, and RISC-V microarchitecture without the need for root permissions or extended system control levels. We cover the methodology of microbenchmarking and the approach of WINIC to collect cycle-accurate performance data for assembly instructions. We show that WINIC can…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: A Policed Quality-of-Service Mechanism for Agentic AI Traffic, Evaluated from Simulation to Real-Kernel Adversarial Testing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Software agents built on large language models generate traffic unlike human web traffic, yet routers have no class for it and cannot verify a sender's claim to be an agent. This paper proposes the Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class (VATC), which combines a reserved Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value declaring agent traffic, a router-side classifier that demotes flows contradicting the declaration to a class served after best-effort traffic, and a rate-limited priority queue. VATC was compared with static Differentiated Services (DiffServ), a dedicated class that trusts the marking, and fq_codel, a per-flow fair-queuing scheduler, in two simulators and on a real Linux kernel. VATC matched DiffServ under steady load. In a constructed burst it cut mean agent queuing delay by 98% relative to DiffServ in simulation (assuming an immediate verdict), at a 12% increase in human delay; most of the gain came from the separate class. Under a spoofed flood in the kernel, the rate limit held human latency 11 times below DiffServ's. Without verification, DiffServ and a tightly configured fq_codel gave legitimate agents lower latency than VATC; a live four-feature classifier then demot…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Uncovering the Memory Hierarchy of Modern NVIDIA GPUs for Accurate Simulation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 等 AI 负载对 GPU 显存系统提出空前要求，但现有工作仍依赖过时的显存层次模型，无法刻画现代硬件的复杂度，导致性能刻画失真、优化策略被误导。

方法 提出 GemAtlas，首个对现代 NVIDIA GPU 显存层次做系统性逆向工程的工作：通过细粒度 SASS 级基准，揭露多级 cache 的 set 关联度、slice 路由与 set-indexing 哈希函数、替换策略、一致性行为与互联拓扑等未记录的微架构细节，并将其集成进 SOTA GPU 模拟框架。

关键数字 平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）在 4 块 GPU 上从 31.69% 降至 22.24%；真实 LLM 算子的 MAPE 从 34.04% 降至 23.98%。

为什么值得看 把模拟精度差距归因到具体微架构细节的系统性工作，对 GPU 性能建模与架构优化研究者直接有用。

阅读原文

item.title: Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Offline Reinforcement Learning with Online Action Selection Enabled by Sparse Gaussian-Process Critics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Start-ups and grade changes remain largely operator-driven, while developing and maintaining dynamic models for model-based control requires substantial engineering effort. Hybrid Offline Learning and Online Optimisation (HOFLON) uses one-step offline reinforcement learning to select actions from historical transition data. In its original implementation, the online objective combines the predicted return from a tree-ensemble critic with an adversarial-autoencoder (AAE) penalty for unfamiliar state-action pairs. We examine the effect of this penalty and replace the critic and AAE with a sparse variational Gaussian-process (sGP) critic. Actions maximise $μ- κσ$, an uncertainty-adjusted estimate of the return from one action followed by the historical operating practice. On the HOFLON polymerisation-reactor benchmark, removing the AAE from HOFLON led to 4 failed start-ups in 15 runs over five critics. At its published weight, the variation in the AAE penalty is four orders of magnitude smaller than the variation in the tree-ensemble critic. Nevertheless, it changes actions when the predicted returns of competing candidates are nearly equal, and paired runs with and without the penalt…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Tri-Stack-PIM: A Heterogeneous Multi-Die 3D-Integrated Processing-in-Memory Architecture for Efficient LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 自回归解码内存带宽受限，现有 3D 堆叠 PIM 架构仍受多重约束：PHY/控制器/DMA 与算力争先进节点基片面积、hybrid-bonding 保护区碎片化基片布局、DRAM 工艺计算 tile 逻辑密度低限制吞吐、非线性操作卸载到宿主重引通信瓶颈。如何一体化解决？

方法：Tri-Stack-PIM 异构三 die 架构：顶部 DRAM die 专职存储、中间成熟工艺缓冲 die 放 PHY/DMA 引擎/近存计算单元、底部先进节点基片 die 专放 SIMD 乘累加阵列。另提出 UBAR 统一缓冲感知 ready 硬件乱序微操作调度器：运行时强制跨 die 依赖正确性、多term 优先级最大化发射槽利用。

关键数字：UBAR 恢复顺序策略可能浪费的多达 90% 周期；架构-数据流联合探索找出的 Pareto 最优配置相对朴素参数选择 EDP 降 33-66×；MHA/GQA/MQA 三种注意力、批大小 1-32 上，几何平均加速相对 GPU 基线 4.95×、相对 AttAcc 2.57×、相对 H2-LLM 1.68×。

为什么值得看：以"三 die 分工"系统化解 3D-PIM 的面积/工艺/调度耦合难题，含乱序调度器与联合探索方法。

原文：Tri-Stack-PIM: A Heterogeneous Multi-Die 3D-Integrated Processing-in-Memory Architecture for Efficient LLM Inference

item.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MIT 近期工作用前沿 LLM agent 读权重写修复（GPT-6 Astra 无梯度修复 Qwen3.5 推理循环，耗 158 agent 轮、8970 万 token、50 次前向请求）——能否把权重空间编程建模为可精确求解的离散优化，绕过昂贵 agent 调用？

方法：Tree-Ising 把修复建模为模型 BF16 权重上的稀疏离散优化：前向统计定义目标（削弱循环方向、强化结论方向、保持生产性 token 上该层输出）；在状态树表示中，允许的编辑为保持共享组指数与尾数的符号翻转与指数移位；目标精确分解为每输出行独立的 QUBO（Ising）问题，GPU 上用模拟退火或量子启发模拟分岔求解。

关键数字：agent 的两层上 MATH-500 达 54.6%，超过 agent 编辑（51.7%），基座模型 7.9%；模拟分岔求解器 55.1% 统计无差异；两个求解器在五个数学 benchmark 全部胜过 agent 编辑；少改 13-17% 权重、BF16 比特翻转少 2.2-2.3×；仅需 4 次前向、零 LLM token，退火配方 GPU 成本约 $0.90。Qwen3.5-2B 上贪婪 GSM8K 从 21.6% 升到 69.4%；概念验证在 IBM Heron 上用 QAOA 跑八变量修复子问题。

为什么值得看：把"读权重修 bug"从昂贵 agent 调用变成 ~$1 的离散优化，权重空间编程的实用化路径。

原文：Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits

item.title: TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Time series analytics has been widely applied across various domains. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) have demonstrated promising results, they still face two major challenges: 1) Most TSFMs mainly rely on stacking Transformer layers to increase parameter size, lacking the ability to adaptively model complex time series patterns from multi-domain data. 2) Current TSFMs are primarily pre-trained for specific tasks, e.g., forecasting or anomaly detection, and a few models support multiple tasks, but they fail to fully leverage task specificity and commonality, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose TimeSeek, a novel generalized time series analytics model that adaptively models time series patterns from multi-domain data and unifies multiple tasks in pre-training. Conceptually, TimeSeek is guided by selective information sharing under domain and task heterogeneity. From the perspective of multi-domain data, we propose a Multi-Domain Feature Extractor that adaptively captures temporal dependencies and channel correlations based on domain-specific characteristics, including progressive multi-scale modeling and adaptive slot cha…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Unused Input: The Initial State as a Conditioning Interface for Recurrent TSFMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast unseen series without task-specific training. Increasingly they are built on recurrent backbones, whose constant per-step cost makes long-context inference cheap, and which, unlike transformers, carry a state. A recurrent backbone computes its prediction from two inputs: the observed context window and the initial recurrent state. In practice only the first is utilised and the initial state is unused by convention. We ask whether the initial state can be utilised in recurrent TSFMs. Using the xLSTM-based zero-shot forecaster TiRex as a case study, we freeze the backbone and train only a small head that writes a context vector into the initial state, so that any change in accuracy is attributable to the injected state rather than to adapted weights. A spectral summary of the input window, learned once and applied unchanged to every series, lowers mean GiftEval MASE by 0.175%, with every seed improving, which neither a parameter-matched LoRA adapter nor a learnable static state reproduces. An embedding of text attached to each series, evaluated on six MoTime datasets, reveals two roles for the state. As a per-dataset adaptation surface, …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Increasingly they are built on recurrent backbones, whose constant per-step cost makes long-context inference cheap, and which, unlike transformers, carry a state. A recurrent backbone computes its prediction from two inputs: the observed context window and the initial recurrent state. In practice only the first is utilised and the initial state is unused by convention. We ask whether the initial state can be utilised in recurrent TSFMs. Using the xLSTM-based zero-shot forecaster TiRex as a case study, we freeze the backbone and train only a small head that writes a context vector into the initial state, so that any change in accuracy is attributable to the injected state rather than to adapted weights. A spectral summary of the input window, learned once and applied unchanged to every series, lowers mean GiftEval MASE by 0.175%, with every seed improving, which neither a parameter-matched LoRA adapter nor a learnable static state reproduces. item.title: TAPCO-G: LLM-Guided Design-Adaptive Timing and Power Co-Optimization with Graph-Based Physical Priors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Post-placement timing and power co-optimization is critical to meeting setup timing targets and reducing power within placement constraints. A cell replacement can improve timing along one path while increasing power or reducing slack on others. Conventional optimizers follow fixed rules for scheduling and accepting repairs, limiting their ability to address design-specific bottlenecks. A large language model (LLM) can propose changes to these rules, but on its own it cannot reliably estimate how a cell replacement affects endpoint slack and power. TAPCO-G combines LLM-guided optimizer adaptation with graph-based physical priors to evaluate candidate cell replacements. The outer loop tunes tool settings using physical-design feedback and revises executable repair policies when tuning stalls. The inner loop anchors delay estimates to static timing analysis snapshots, accounts for upstream driver-load changes, and propagates delay shifts to timing endpoints. It combines these estimates with coarse-to-fine power screening to prioritize candidates for physical trials. TAPCO-G produced placement-legal, logic-equivalent implementations and outscored CERBERUS on all eight ASAP7 benchmarks…

item.title: SkipLane: Write-Once, Conflict-Free Accumulation for Zero-Skipping CNN Engines on FPGAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：CNN 加速器跳过零激活省乘法，但压缩输入窗口的乘积属于不同输出列、必须合并——此前用 read-modify-write（RMW）合并，使稀疏输入比稠密还慢（87% 稀疏度亦然）。如何让累加路径无冲突？

方法：SkipLane 让整个累加路径 write-once：每条 kernel row 在独立 lane 处理，lane 用三个寄存器持部分和、每周期最多退休三个已完成列到不会冲突的内存 bank；lane 与输入通道只在读出时求和，任何部分和都不回读；零权重闲置的乘法器同趟计算第二个滤波器。

关键数字：RTL 仿真中引擎在 70% 稀疏度内保持在前端界 0.5% 以内，50-80% 稀疏度下比 18-bank 理想 RMW 的 SCNN 式散射累加器快 1.10-1.26×；六个引擎在 PYNQ-Z2 上达 140MHz、用 21.1k LUT，板上跑 LeNet-5 比特精确；conv1 比稠密引擎少 1.94× 周期（端到端快 1.26×），conv2（行仅 13 像素宽）达到稠密速度的 0.87×。

为什么值得看：彻底移除稀疏累加的 RMW 与 bank 冲突，稀疏输入不再慢于稠密，FPGA 零跳过引擎的实用进展。

原文：SkipLane: Write-Once, Conflict-Free Accumulation for Zero-Skipping CNN Engines on FPGAs

item.title: SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：混合模型用线性注意力把历史压缩进定长循环状态，但现有服务系统对这些冗余状态稠密读写——发现 QKV 集中在稳定低维子空间（linear attention sink），状态有效低秩且秩跨状态变化，却每步全量读写，内存流量随批大小增长并主导解码成本。如何压缩？

方法：SinkState 在整个推理中把每个循环状态存为自适应低秩形式：带缓冲更新、限制在顶部子空间的局部 SVD；其余分量异步在 CPU 上整合。

关键数字：四个混合模型（Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet 层，4B 到 120B 参数）上，相对 Mamba-SSM 与 FLA，循环状态峰值内存最高降 2.6×（平均 1.9×），解码最高加速 1.58×（平均 1.25×），精度保持。

为什么值得看：用"注意力 sink"现象把线性注意力状态压缩做到服务级，混合模型解码成本的关键优化。

原文：SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving

item.title: Scaling Shapley Energy Attribution to Large LLM Batches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

LLM services have become essential infrastructure for applications such as chat assistants and coding agents. Service providers need to attribute resource consumption to individual requests for purposes such as billing. Among these resources, energy is a key metric for assessing the cost of serving each request. However, serving engines batch requests together, and GPUs report only aggregate energy consumption. Providers typically estimate each request's share in proportion to its token consumption, but this approach can produce substantially unfair estimates. The Shapley value provides a principled solution to fair energy allocation, but computing it directly requires $2^N-1$ GPU runs for $N$ requests, which is infeasible for large batches. To address this problem, we propose StepSplit. Across GPU generations, we observe that the energy consumed by each inference step, a forward pass over a batch, consists of a shared energy, largely due to reading model weights, and a request-specific energy. We derive a closed-form Shapley value: each request is charged its own energy plus an equal part of the shared energy of every step in which it participates. A microbenchmark of 2.5-17.8 min…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sanity Checks for Attention Surgery: Null Models and Matched Interventions for Representation-Motivated Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Transformer architectural modifications frequently measure a statistic on internal representations, observe that it is large, remove it architecturally, and report an improvement. Interpreting that sequence requires evaluating whether the statistic exceeds its noise floor, whether it survives a geometric null, and whether the training gain requires the specific direction removed. We formulate these requirements as three reusable checks and apply them to self-attention removal, which deletes the component of an attention head's output aligned with its own value vector. Across nine multi-head pretrained models (5,408 heads, 124M to 6.9B parameters), an earlier-position causal null accounts for 48% to 63% of the head-value cosine alignment, with no monotone scale trend. Under grouped-query attention, this alignment is specific to each head's own key-value group and reverses across groups (+0.24 to +0.27 within-group, -0.11 to -0.19 across-group). Split-half reliability demonstrates that the per-head intervention effect is resolvable in GPT-2 ($r_Δ= 0.80$) but attenuated in Pythia-160M (0.42) and Pythia-410M (0.53), whereas structural self-cosine reliability is near-perfect in all thre…

item.title: SLIC: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning Small LMs for Multi-Turn Analog Circuit Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Analog integrated circuit (IC) design is a multi-turn, simulator-grounded engineering task that demands iterative reasoning over coupled performance tradeoffs, yet proprietary process design kits (PDKs) make hosted large language model workflows difficult to deploy in practical design settings. We present SLIC (Small LM Iterating on Circuits), a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that trains a 4B-scale, locally deployable language model for closed-loop analog circuit optimization. SLIC pairs structured circuit representations with discretized relative-update actions, domain- and success-gated multiobjective rewards, and Reward-Guided Rollout Steering (RGRS), which turns per-step simulator feedback into signals for both policy learning and online rollout construction in this sparse, highly constrained domain. We further release an open, goal-conditioned benchmark of 41 amplifier topologies with standardized protocols for in-distribution validation, held-out topology evaluation, and cross-technology-node transfer. Trained solely with open source 65 nm CMOS predictive technology models (PTM), SLIC-Random achieves 87.1% in-distribution four-specification Pass@1 within eight turns, sur…

item.title: SFU-Sim: Bit-Exact Reverse Engineering of NVIDIA MUFU and Validation of PTX Paths
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：复现 GPU 数值行为需预测特殊函数指令的精确输出，但厂商文档只给函数语义与误差界，不固定输出比特模式——如何获得 bit-exact 的 MUFU 模型？

方法：SFU-Sim 在真实 GPU 上黑盒逆向 NVIDIA 多函数单元（MUFU）指令：先建模单条裸 MUFU 指令，再叠加反汇编中的周边操作建模完整 PTX 路径。以 SIN/COS 为完整案例，还原 PTX→SASS 编译路径、段结构、等价系数表与有限宽算术。模型覆盖被测 Blackwell GPU 上 12 种常见 MUFU 形式与两种 BF16 形式。

关键数字：在 Ampere、Ada Lovelace、Blackwell 三代架构上穷举比较每个被测 PTX 路径的指定输入域——FP16 与 FP32 路径分别覆盖全部 2^16 与 2^32 输入编码，模型输出与硬件逐比特一致、零失配。SFU-Sim 直接由输入计算输出，无需查表、无需物理 GPU，已开源。

为什么值得看：比特级精确的 GPU 特殊函数组件，可直接嵌入指令模拟器或作为硬件设计/功能验证的算术参考。

原文：SFU-Sim: Bit-Exact Reverse Engineering of NVIDIA MUFU and Validation of PTX Paths

item.title: Retargetable Compilation for Tensor Kernels via a Unified Layout Abstraction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：现代硬件加速器靠专用指令 + 紧管内存层次达到高性能，指令对操作数强加严格布局要求（张量片段位置、组织、并行单元访问方式）——但现有编译器要么把布局要求散落在手工程序与局部调度规则里，要么只支持单一目标类。如何跨后端统一建模指令布局？

方法：Arknife 可重定向编译器，把指令可见布局作为一等指令语义。核心是约束式布局代数：张量布局把逻辑轴映射到跨并行层级与内存空间的硬件轴；指令操作数声明布局要求，目标提供的修复解决冲突；布局跨程序全局求解。ISA 特定布局事实由目标侧指令描述提供而非硬编码进编译器，重定向复用布局代数与求解器、只定义新目标指令。

关键数字：x86 CPU、Hexagon NPU 与 NVIDIA A100 GPU 三目标评估：A100 上匹配 cuBLAS；x86 与 Hexagon 上比厂商优化库快 2.17× 与 3.78×，比可重定向编译器 MISAAL 快 5.08× 与 4.53×。

为什么值得看：把指令布局从"隐式约定"提为一等语义的约束代数，一次抽象跨三类硬件，重定向成本大幅下降。

原文：Retargetable Compilation for Tensor Kernels via a Unified Layout Abstraction

item.title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：投机解码加速由期望接受长度（EAL）决定，但标准训练目标（交叉熵、KL、TV）只做分布匹配，近期的 block-level 目标也只是 EAL 的代理而非精确形式——有的在目标分布续写上平均后期接受率而非被接受 token 选择的验证分支，引入可反转梯度方向的协方差 gap。能否直接优化真实 EAL？

方法：推导 REAL loss——用路径权重做无偏估计、Rao-Blackwellization 降方差，端到端优化真实期望接受长度。受控 loss 级对比：Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 目标 + Domino drafter。

关键数字：REAL 在 9 个任务子集、5 个评估种子上的概率服务接受长度全面胜过 WTV、VSD、DBLast 与静态 LK 基线；仅改训练 loss，drafter 架构与推理过程零改动。参考实现已在 GitHub 开源。

为什么值得看：把投机解码训练目标从"代理"精确化为"真实 EAL"，只换 loss 即可提升，落地成本极低。

原文：REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding

item.title: RB-LDC: Redundancy-Balanced Latent Coding for Noise-Robust Diffusion Latents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Latent diffusion models decode approximately correct latents, making decoder sensitivity to perturbations relevant to image quality. After whitening, forward diffusion corrupts every direction at the same signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), despite unequal decoder sensitivities. We study an invertible linear layer between the encoder and diffusion process that shifts each direction's log-SNR. Its linear minimum mean-square-error (LMMSE) recovery risk has an exact spectral expression for any whitened latent distribution. Under an energy budget and a floor ensuring invertibility, minimizing decoder-sensitivity-weighted LMMSE risk integrated over the diffusion schedule yields a unique optimal allocation. The layer aligns with the decoder's expected pullback metric and equalizes marginal risk reduction across directions, computed by a deterministic spectral solver. At large budgets, the allocation follows a power law in sensitivity whose exponent is determined by the low-SNR tail of the loss weighting: one half for noise prediction and two thirds for data prediction under the cosine schedule, with a crossover on truncated schedules. We instantiate this principle as RB-LDC using Jacobian-based…

item.title: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling …

item.title: Plumbline: When the Loss Lies, Validating LLM Training Correctly
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大规模 LLM 训练正确性难以保证——故障可潜伏在运行任一部分，且表现随框架与依赖库不同；响亮与静默故障都耗时难查，单个故障可毁掉长训练（晚崩溃或只在最终评估分数偏低）。如何系统验证训练正确性？

方法：Plumbline（Amazon 生产系统）检查训练生命周期每一环：从训练数据、运行、到服务的模型、各模型新增层乃至整个运行；诊断复用这些检查做故障根因追踪。支持两个 agentic 用例：Day-0 onboarding（新模型训练后先验证再依赖）与训练故障根因追踪。方法论设计为跨模型与框架可迁移。

关键数字：3 个框架 × 5 个模型上发现 61 个问题、其中 32 个为静默故障；42 个已修复或上报上游（8 个由作者首先提出）；61 个问题归为 7 类故障模式。

为什么值得看：生产级训练正确性验证的实战样本，静默故障占比过半，对训练基础设施团队有直接借鉴价值。

原文：Plumbline: When the Loss Lies, Validating LLM Training Correctly

item.title: Placing LLM Lookup Tables by Per-Layer Prefetch Deadlines
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：DeepSeek-V4.1 的 203GB Engram n-gram 查表目前驻留宿主 DRAM（4-GPU 服务进程 223GiB 中占 190）——能否按各层预取截止时间把表放到更便宜的存储层级？

方法：观察行索引只依赖输入 token，读操作可与更早层重叠；V4.1 两个 Engram 层窗口相差 30×（0.3 vs 9.3ms），该截止时间连同会话复用与共享设备争用决定每张表可用层级。构建 SlackTier（SGLang 表层级）：step 起始发起全部查找，先读短窗口层，GPU 行缓存跨层拆分，路径在 decode CUDA graph 内且与原始 gather 比特精确。

关键数字：Layer 14 的表可无缓存放 NVMe 且无可测解码开销；两张表放四块 NVMe 盘时，agent/chat 回放平均每输出 token 时间最多升 1.4%，宿主内存从 212 降到 34 GiB；经 RDMA 从别节点内存读表则两张表都不需缓存、一份副本服务两个实例；把释放内存用作宿主 KV 缓存（同预算）使 KV 受限 agent 负载中位吞吐升 36%、p90 TTFT 从 38 秒降到 24 秒。

为什么值得看：用"截止时间"而非经验法则决定查表存储层级，实测把 203GB 表从 DRAM 挪走几乎无代价。

原文：Placing LLM Lookup Tables by Per-Layer Prefetch Deadlines

item.title: Performance Portability Explained: Insights from accelerating ICON microphysics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Scientific computing is under increasing pressure to adapt to HPC hardware that is shaped by AI workloads. In these modern ecosystems, extracting reasonable performance without investing major engineering effort is a central issue for domain scientists. Correctness constraints and intricate reference implementations represent further impediments to development. Instead of using a double-precision implementation as a reference, considering the underlying scientific problem directly opens more opportunities for performance improvements when updating and rewriting applications. We take seven different portability frameworks---covering pragma-based, DSL, and data-centric approaches---and evaluate them on a microphysics kernel of the ICON climate model. Our performance benchmarks show that each different HPC system benefits from a different combination of optimizations, so we develop the measure of framework expressivity to gauge how easily each framework can customize portable implementations in this way.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Parallel Broyden Methods for Efficiently Evaluating Nonlinear State Space Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Nonlinear state space models are typically evaluated sequentially, limiting their ability to exploit modern parallel hardware. Recent work has shown that state space models can be evaluated in parallel by reformulating evaluation as a root-finding problem, which can be solved with a parallel form of Newton's method. However, exact Newton methods require expensive multiplication of dense Jacobian matrices, and quasi-Newton methods based on diagonal approximations, while more scalable, are often slow to converge because they neglect interactions across state dimensions. We introduce a novel quasi-Newton approach based on Broyden's method, which captures coupling terms with diagonal-plus-low-rank approximations to blocks of the Jacobian. We construct the approximations from trajectory secants, avoiding automatic differentiation while retaining the favorable scaling of diagonal approximations and remaining compatible with parallel scan through rank compression. We prove finite-step recovery of the exact trajectory under the compressed scan, and show that convergence is tracked by the compression error and by the block approximation error along the current trajectory error, rather than …

item.title: PSL-RGHA: Parallel Split Learning with Reference Gradient Half-Space Alignment for Mitigating Gradient Divergence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

The escalating complexity of deep neural networks hinders the deployment of federated learning (FL) on resource-constrained devices, especially for multimedia applications such as on-device image classification and speech recognition. Parallel split learning (PSL) has emerged as a promising solution by offloading a substantial portion of the computational workload to the server through layer-wise model partitioning, making it particularly suitable for resource-limited visual and speech intelligence scenarios. However, the absence of client-side aggregation renders PSL sus ceptible to severe training divergence and potential convergence failure under heterogeneous data distributions. To address this challenge, we propose PSL-RGHA, a gradient-aligned PSL framework that employs reference gradient half-space alignment mechanism to mitigate training divergence among client devices. PSL-RGHA comprises two novel components: reference gradient progressive construction (RGPC) and gradient half-space alignment (GHA). item.title: PARDIG: Global Precipitation Estimates Learned from Sparse Satellite Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Estimating precipitation at the global scale is vital for Earth system science and disaster response, yet observational coverage and measurement precision remain constrained. Existing solutions provide options that trade off desirable traits such as skill, latency, geographical coverage, temporal coverage, and spatial and temporal resolution. We present PARDIG, an artificial intelligence framework based on a spherical graph-mesh transformer architecture that produces near-real-time global precipitation estimates. PARDIG is trained on dense multi-modal inputs, including atmospheric state analyses and multi-spectral geostationary satellite imagery, to predict sparse, high-precision precipitation measurements from spaceborne radar. At inference, the trained model is applied densely across the globe at $0.1^\circ$ spatial and 15-minute temporal resolution, producing complete near-real-time precipitation fields from 2016 to the present, alongside a historical variant extending the record back to 1999. Evaluation against three independent radar networks (over the US, Europe, and Japan) and against over 36,000 surface stations worldwide shows that PARDIG consistently outperforms IMERG V07…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Omni-JEV: Text and Dual-Stream Speech Decisions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

A user utterance does not uniquely determine the next action in full-duplex dialogue: its consequences depend on the assistant's response state and interaction history. Speech activity, utterance completion, and interruption intent provide related evidence, whose implications for a response require an explicit action policy. We formulate this task at collected-segment endpoints and introduce Omni-JEV, which maps text or role-indexed user and assistant-reference speech to probabilities over five interaction actions. An aligned speech-to-speech understanding backbone encodes the acoustic roles separately and shares its candidate readout with text inputs. Bilingual weak supervision supports cross-entropy fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning for probability-sensitive decisions (RLCD). We compare Gaussian-logit and categorical Choice RLCD from the same supervised initialization under matched training exposure, observing different trade-offs between classification and probability quality. Gaussian Omni-JEV achieves test accuracies of 84.08% for audio and 96.55% for text. This common action interface supports decisions about when a full-duplex voice assistant should respond, pre…

item.title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Many-query analyses, in which a computational model is repeatedly evaluated, play an important role in uncertainty quantification and optimization for engineering design. However, many-query analyses can be prohibitively expensive when considering high-fidelity numerical models, especially those governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). Surrogate modeling replaces costly simulations with cheap approximations, enabling practical uncertainty quantification and design workflows. Machine learning (ML) approaches to surrogate modeling have gained significant traction in the development of surrogate models due to their non-intrusive nature; they do not require access to the underlying simulation code. The Operator Inference (OpInf) approach, in particular, fits reduced operators to state and corresponding time derivative data. However, high-fidelity training data is scarce due to limited computational budgets, and OpInf models trained on such scarce data often exhibit high variance, a critical liability in high-risk engineering design. We propose Multifidelity Operator Inference (MF-OpInf), which reduces this variance by supplementing scarce high-fidelity snapshots with abundant…

Machine learning (ML) approaches to surrogate modeling have gained significant traction in the development of surrogate models due to their non-intrusive nature; they do not require access to the underlying simulation code. The Operator Inference (OpInf) approach, in particular, fits reduced operators to state and corresponding time derivative data. However, high-fidelity training data is scarce due to limited computational budgets, and OpInf models trained on such scarce data often exhibit high variance, a critical liability in high-risk engineering design. We propose Multifidelity Operator Inference (MF-OpInf), which reduces this variance by supplementing scarce high-fidelity snapshots with abundant…

发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly composed into multi-agent workflows to accomplish complex and multi-step tasks. As the open-weight models continue to close the performance gap with the proprietary ones, model parameters are becoming a less significant source of competitive advantage in the artificial intelligence market. Yet how these models are efficiently scheduled onto distributed infrastructure such as the cloud, with respect to overall latency, monetary cost and resource utilization, remains largely unaddressed in the literature despite being an increasingly critical problem. Existing agentic workflow frameworks mostly focus on output quality and task success rates over popular benchmarks, rarely accounting for execution dynamics of LLM-based agents such as inference latency, computation power of heterogeneous resources, cloud-specific billing period and resource provisioning overheads. Therefore, this paper formulates multi-agent scheduling in cloud computing as a multi-objective optimization problem that jointly minimizes makespan and cost while maximizing resource utilization. item.title: MouldIt: Data Efficiency of Multi-Task Temporal Representation Learning in Injection Moulding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Smart industrial solutions that can address multiple tasks require models that understand the underlying processes. We examine representation learning for modeling the injection moulding process as an example of such solutions. We consider its data efficiency and multi-modal benefit compared to classical machine learning alternatives. To this end, we synthesize a process-informed dataset based on a real reference cycle of an Erlanger Träger part. We then introduce MouldIt, a temporal convolution and attention based variational autoencoder that reconstructs in-mould signals, while classifying parts as acceptable or as one of our synthetic failure modes. We evaluate MouldIt on two tasks, known-class classification and unknown-class detection, across nine dataset sizes in single-modal and multi-modal settings. We compare it with an accept-all baseline and the classical methods k-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, random forests, and principal component analysis, which we adapt to support both tasks. MouldIt outperforms classical methods across both tasks from 4000 cycles in the single-modal setting and from 2000 cycles in the multi-modal setting. It achieves part sorting losses o…

item.title: Metamorphic testing of learned AC optimal power flow surrogates reveals representation dependence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Evaluating a learned AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF) surrogate on one grid serialization cannot show whether its accuracy depends on that encoding. We test this dependence with thirteen metamorphic relations, each specifying when a transformation is valid and how to compare its outputs. Our audit covers 17 model and pipeline configurations: two released trained checkpoints and 15 random-weight architecture or mechanism controls. Every configuration violates at least six relations, even at reporting tolerances ten times tighter or looser. For GridSFM-Open v1.1, source inspection and intermediate-tensor interventions point to an indexing bug and three noncanonical or numerically unstable preprocessing choices; a repaired checkpoint remains untested. In a separate case500 training experiment, augmentation lowers transformed-view error in three of four models and median discrepancy and constraint-violation P95 in all four. These benefits depend on the training protocol: some relations worsen, and every evaluated prediction remains AC infeasible. A GPU/CPU eigensolver mismatch accounts for most of the large raw-Laplacian-baseline gain. We recommend reporting representation consistency al…

item.title: Massive Activations Confound Sparse Autoencoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are commonly evaluated by variance explained and ablation damage. We show how massive activations undermine both evaluations, and propose a correction. Massive activations cause up to 99.9% of activation variance to lie along the first principal component (PC1). Because the PC1 component has no unique sparse decomposition, each SAE run rebuilds it from a different set of features. These features dominate importance rankings: an average of 47 of the 50 most important features are unmatched in a separate run, compared with about 27 of a random 50. A dictionary can also report 99.96% of variance explained while leaving 33% of the variance outside PC1 unexplained. We bypass PC1 by training the SAE on activations with PC1 removed, then adding PC1 to the reconstruction. In affected models, the top-50 feature sharing rate rises from 4-39.5% to 73-99.5%. At the same TopK sparsity, the resulting SAE degrades the model up to 44% less and reduces content reconstruction error by up to 33.9%.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. Our results show that the reward model trained with the proposed gaze distribution achieves higher preference prediction accuracy than a baseline model. Moreover, some results from our experiments are qualitatively consistent with established findings on human attention during reading, suggesting that they potentially capture cognitively meaningful aspects of human attention allocation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. item.title: Forward-Value Discretization: Faster Stochastic Diffusion Sampling Without High-Order Approximation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Stochastic diffusion samplers often require substantially more neural function evaluations (NFEs) than deterministic samplers to achieve comparable sample quality. Although higher-order discretization accelerates deterministic sampling, its benefits for stochastic sampling remains unclear. We establish matching upper and worst-case lower bounds showing that stochastic samplers with higher-order approximations remain first-order convergent, even with exact score functions. Thus, increasing the approximation order does not generally improve the convergence order. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce forward-value discretization, a training-free framework that evaluates the data/noise prediction model at a lookahead estimate constructed from previous predictions. For deterministic sampling, the resulting Forward DPMSolver (F-DPMSolver), improves sample quality at low NFE budgets through its DDIM-based variant, despite remaining first-order convergent. For stochastic sampling, we develop Forward DDPM (F-DDPM), which evaluates the model at a cleaner lookahead point adjusted for subsequent noise injection. This estimate reuses both the previous model prediction and the previously i…

item.title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：并行投机解码一次前向提议整块草稿 token，但高负载下 drafting 消耗大量 step 时间且大部分被丢弃（从不被验证）；草稿与验证长度在批次内耦合，如何按请求联合分配？

方法：提出 work-conserving speculation（WCS）与原型 ForeSpark：① 上下文感知 pre-draft 估计器，从目标模型上下文特征预测各候选长度接受率；② 轻量联合草稿-验证调度器，全局排序同时选定两个长度；③ post-draft 预算分配，把验证花在最可能接受的 token 上。

关键数字：高负载下 drafting 占 step 时间高达 40%，其中大部分被丢弃；vLLM 实现上，相同每请求生成率下吞吐比 SOTA DSpark 高 1.77×、比自回归解码高 2.49×。

为什么值得看：把投机解码的草稿长度从"固定整块"变为按请求联合调度的预算分配，服务负载场景下收益显著。

原文：ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding

item.title: Federated Learning for Cross-Regional Epidemic Forecasting with Asynchronous Outbreaks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Objective: Epidemic outbreaks are often asynchronous across regions, yet collaborative forecasting is hampered by privacy laws and heterogeneous public health interventions. We developed and evaluated, as a proof of concept, a federated learning (FL) framework for cross-regional COVID-19 forecasting under asynchronous outbreaks among Guangdong, Macau, and Portugal, while maintaining data sovereignty. Methods: Using daily case data from WHO and China CDC for the three regions, whose outbreaks were asynchronous and interventions heterogeneous, we trained Long Short-Term Memory networks via FL for short-term forecasting, benchmarked against localized and centralized training using Root Mean Square Error, Mean Absolute Error, and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error. All experiments used the Flower FL framework with consistent hyperparameters across sites. Publicly available, aggregated case-count data were used so that the centralized benchmark could be computed as a reference. Results: The dataset comprised 1,233 daily observations (411 days) of new confirmed COVID-19 cases from November 24, 2021, to January 8, 2023. item.title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Exploiting What NVIDIA Profilers Hide: Fast and Accurate Analytical GPU Performance Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：GPU 硬件配置设计空间越来越大，cycle-level 模拟器太慢，而现有解析模型需在目标配置上重估或缩放每个 warp stall，跨配置预测不准——如何快速且准确地跨配置预测性能？

方法：关键观察——固定延迟 stall 跨配置不变，排队 stall 才随各硬件单元压力变化。据此提出 ForeSight 排队解析模型：复用硬件上测得的固定延迟 stall，按单元压力重算排队 stall；配套 UnitSight profiler 恢复 NVIDIA 官方 profiler 聚合隐藏的各单元计数器。

关键数字：九款 NVIDIA GPU 硬件配置上，内核执行时间 MAPE 8.3%（最佳基线 14.1%）；vLLM LLM 推理端到端时间 MAPE 2.0%；比 cycle 级模拟器 Accel-Sim 快 49×；用 ForeSight 探索 H20 衍生配置找到 1.78× 的 LLM 推理配置。

为什么值得看：不再为每个新配置重跑模拟，基于实测 stall 复用做解析预测，误差与速度兼得。

原文：Exploiting What NVIDIA Profilers Hide: Fast and Accurate Analytical GPU Performance Modeling

item.title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. item.title: Energy-Proportional Serverless Computing on SBC Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Serverless 承诺按需运行代码，但底层服务器空闲时仍消耗大部分电力——能耗并不随负载归零。函数无状态性能否让 scale-to-zero 从函数实例扩展到物理节点？

方法：基于 tinyFaaS 在单板计算机（SBC）集群上构建平台，把节点电源状态纳入 worker 选择：空闲即断电、负载上来再开机。

关键数字：物理集群上突发型轨迹平均功耗降 39.6%、稀疏轨迹降 46.7%，突发负载中位延迟无可测变化；代价在尾部——所有 worker 关机时到达的调用需等约一分钟节点启动；持续负载下表现如常开集群。

为什么值得看：把能量成比例从实例级推到物理节点级，用函数无状态性换取集群级功耗收益，方法简单直接可复现。

原文：Energy-Proportional Serverless Computing on SBC Clusters

item.title: Dual-Core Tensor Wheel Decomposition with Structure-Cached Acceleration for Tensor Recovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Tensor wheel decomposition captures complex correlations in high-dimensional data through interactions between outer-ring factors and a high-order central core. However, updating these components requires the explicit construction and manipulation of large-scale matrices, which limits computational efficiency and incurs particularly high computational and memory costs for the central-core update. To address these limitations, we propose dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW), which factorizes the central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond. Each core is coupled to a different group of outer-ring factors. We further propose a structure-cached acceleration strategy that avoids explicit large-scale matrix multi- plications and caches intermediate tensors generated during tensor network contractions for reuse across block updates. This reuse reduces redundant computation and avoids the explicit construction of large matrices. Complexity analysis and experiments show that the strategy based on structural caching accelerates optimization compared with explicit and implicit up- date schemes while limiting the increase in peak memory as the ranks grow. item.title: DnNP: Denoising Input Uncertainty in Neural Processes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Neural Processes (NPs) are flexible meta-learning models capable of uncertainty quantification across diverse applications. However, the standard NP framework assumes access to noise-free inputs. This is unrealistic in many practical settings, where sensor noise or measurement errors are unavoidable. This discrepancy between model assumptions and real-world data can significantly degrade prediction quality and uncertainty estimates. We introduce Denoising Neural Processes (DnNPs), a principled extension of the NP framework that explicitly models input uncertainty. We train DnNPs via variational inference. DnNPs jointly learn to denoise corrupted inputs and perform meta-learning, making them robust to noisy training data. We demonstrate DnNPs' effectiveness on both synthetic and real-world datasets, showing consistent improvements in prediction and uncertainty quantification compared to standard NPs. On PM2.5 spatial interpolation from real-world air quality sensors, DnNP reduces RMSE by up to 30% and NLL by up to 73% relative to standard NPs. We also provide theoretical grounding: we show that the Bayes-optimal predictor under noisy inputs belongs to the DnNP model class, and that …

item.title: Discovering Structurally Plausible and Interpretable Cognitive Models with Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Computational cognitive modeling has traditionally relied on manual model construction, which is a time-intensive process that requires substantial domain expertise. Although recent LLM-based approaches have begun to automate model generation, they often prioritize predictive accuracy at the expense of structural plausibility and parameter identifiability. We introduce DisCo, an LLM-guided framework that discovers interpretable symbolic cognitive models through evolutionary search with two structural components: a Validator that filters structurally invalid models, and a Cleaner that promotes parameter identifiability by removing redundant parameters. Across three behavioral tasks, DisCo consistently discovers models that achieve performance competitive with task-specific baselines. Ablation analyses show that the Validator is important for recovering psychologically meaningful structure. Without this component, models tend to violate behavioral constraints and show less consistent associations with external cognitive measures. These results suggest that LLM-driven model discovery, when coupled with appropriate structural constraints, can yield cognitively plausible models that go …

item.title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data a…

item.title: Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference as Its Consequence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：优化后的浮点推理在不同硬件/编译器/线程数下会产生不同比特——跨环境不可复现。能否让真实模型的推理在精确整数算术下运行？

方法：开源 tritify 运行时，让真实模型（decoder-only LM、MoE decoder、Segment Anything 2.1 图像/视频栈）整个运行时前向路径走精确整数算术，浮点仅限离线量化与验证参考。三项主张逐一验证：① 跨硬件可复现（跨 CPU 指令集、跨 CPU/GPU 输出比特一致，附输出 SHA-256）；② 决策保真（整数路径复现浮点参考在测试模型与输入上的决策，OLMoE-1B-7B 与 1060 亿参数 MoE 十六层逐层保真无悬崖）；③ 位置无关（计算可跨指令集、CPU/GPU、联网机器拆分，输出比特零影响）。

关键数字：GLM-4.5-Air（106,852,251,264 参数、427GB 整数码）跨三台机器生成答案，与单主机参考比特一致——没有任何一台能单独在 RAM 中容纳其整数码。

为什么值得看：整数算术推理把"可复现"变成可验证的硬保证，支撑不信任服务器/设备群上的可验证分布式推理。

原文：Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference

item.title: Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. They must therefore decide what to write down and what to read back, and when to do either. Recent work has begun to use on-policy distillation (OPD) to make memory control part of the policy, relying on memory tools and compaction protocols that lie outside either model's pre-training. However, this weakens the distillation on both sides: the teacher cannot give useful guidance on an interface it has never used, and the student samples too few meaningful memory actions for that guidance to take effect. To study this problem, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym II (CAMG-II), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, AutoResearch, General, and Visual. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG-II provides ordinary Bash access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling the policy to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory across context replacements. We also introduce Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II (CAMP-II), which trains a single policy jointly across all five environments with fully asynchronous OP…

item.title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations, while PACM consistently improves prediction across diverse chemical systems. Chem World and our PACM-powered drug-property prediction Agent support generalizable chemical modeling and offer a foundation for AI-assisted biomedical research and drug for…

item.title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. During inference, semantically similar graph paths are retrieved for each question and used as both information and in-context examples for the reasoning process. Candidate failure modes are extracted from the question and analysed independently through dedicated LLM calls, which generate plausible failure-to-observa…

item.title: Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 更新后能否直接复用旧模型的 KV 缓存避免重复计算共享上下文？权重变化后缓存究竟保留了什么？

方法：研究四次模型更新间的直接缓存复用，重点案例 DeepSeek-V4-Flash→Flash-0731；提出 Functional Cache Divergence（比较复用与原生缓存下的 next-token 分布）刻画行为差异；用 answer-margin 分析解释正确检索决策如何在内部状态大变下存活。

关键数字：检索准确率跨更新差异很大（近原生到大损失不一）；已有源缓存时，三个长前缀 QA benchmark 上复用达到中位 TTFT 加速 2.10-5.08×；自然文本续写下复用更忠实原生行为，而单 token 检索任务中兼容性随前缀长度增长下降；首 token 一致也不保证答案内容或停止行为一致。

为什么值得看：首次区分"任务效用"与"原生推理保真度"两个判据，为跨版本 KV 缓存复用策略提供实证依据。

原文：Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study

item.title: Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefix-cached agent 服务在相同基础负载下，几分钟的额外到达就可能导致服务器进入持续降级区（命中率暴跌、吞吐减半、backlog 持续增长）——这种亚稳态是否真实存在、能否预测与恢复？

方法：对 vLLM 做对照实验：相同基础负载 + 短突发 vs 无突发孪生服务器；提出一阶工作负载平衡条件刻画降级区可排空边界；测试准入节流、挂起已准入会话（基于容量上限）、CPU offload 与预算器四种恢复/预防策略。

关键数字：突发后 vLLM 进入约 10% 命中率、约一半吞吐、backlog 增长 70 分钟的降级区，9/12 对中无突发孪生保持健康、无反向案例；Qwen3-32B 与 SGLang 上也复现（后者容忍更大触发）；准入节流仅恢复 7 个塌陷运行中的 1 个，容量上限挂起准入则几分钟内全部恢复；预算器在所有测试运行中阻止了故障。

为什么值得看：揭示 agent 服务缓存经济性的隐藏脆弱点——"缓存一旦崩塌会自我强化"，恢复策略实证可操作。

原文：Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving

item.title: Bootstrapped On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language models by distilling teacher predictions on student-generated trajectories, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) removes the need for an external teacher by using a reference-conditioned copy of the model as the teacher. Despite its great early improvements, we find that OPSD does not remain consistently effective under continued training and can eventually suffer substantial performance degradation. We study this training behavior and link the degradation to a growing mismatch between the evolving reference-free student and the frozen privileged teacher. In the early stage of OPSD, the privileged teacher remains closely aligned with the student and provides useful guidance for improving the student's generation trajectories. However, as training progresses, the growing distributional mismatch between the privileged teacher and reference-free student can cause the teacher to provide misleading supervision, ultimately degrading student performance. This phenomenon motivates us to first leverage privileged reference supervision to acquire useful knowledge and then transfer it to a fresh student. We introduce Bootstrapped On-Policy Di…

item.title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all …

item.title: Auditing the Judge: Internal Signals for LLM Reasoning Assurance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Language-model systems use self-judgment to decide which answers to release, review, or recompute. Because intervention is costly, an assurance score must rank errors well at the available budget, not merely over the full ranking. We compare the judge's continuous verdict-token score with a supervised correctness probe trained on attention-head activations from the same prompt. Exact identities link fixed-budget error recall to residual risk and show that AUROC averages recall over all budgets. Across three open 7-12B models on GSM8K and MATH, the probe finds 1.3-22.5 additional percentage points of errors at 5% review in all six model-dataset settings (median 7.4 points). At 10% routing, probe-guided allocation improves accuracy over equal-cost random allocation in both GSM8K experiments, but beats judge-guided routing only for the weaker judge. Cross-dataset transfer lowers probe AUROC for every model in both directions relative to target-domain training. Because dataset, weight precision, and generation budget change together, this measures a joint protocol shift rather than a dataset-only effect. Internal signals can improve supervised, in-domain budget allocation, but are not …

item.title: AdjointFlow: Accelerating Scientific Inverse Problems with Physics-Based Transport
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF

Inverse problems are ubiquitous across scientific applications ranging from seismic imaging to astrophysics to nondestructive testing, yet classical solvers often struggle with nonconvexity and repeated evaluations of expensive physical models. Diffusion models can amortize this computation offline, but largely data-driven conditional models underutilize known physics and suffer from ill-conditioned transport maps when the target distribution is concentrated. Plug-and-play (PnP) methods explicitly leverage the physical model to guide a learned prior, improving data consistency but reintroducing costly iterative computations. We instead propose AdjointFlow, a framework built on stochastic interpolants that injects the known physics into the generative transport itself. We design a data-dependent, adjoint-based initialization to reduce transport distance to the target, modify the transport velocity to remain regular as the endpoint distributions concentrate, and parameterize the network to build the initialization directly into the learned velocity. Together, these enable accurate reconstruction at substantially lower cost than generative models starting from Gaussian noise. Experime…

item.title: A Margin Perspective on LoRA: Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting and Adapter Merging (MaLoRA)
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-10　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LoRA 除参数高效外，实践中还表现出对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性和独立 adapter 可合并性——这两个对持续学习与多任务学习至关重要的性质，理论上一直缺乏解释。

方法：在近正交任务区间 + ℓ2 正则的多类线性分类下，用统一"边际视角"分析 LoRA：刻画各正则区间的最优 adapter；证明中间正则区间下最优 adapter 对齐微调数据的最大边际解；由此导出预训练/微调数据上的边际闭式表达式，揭示正则参数控制保留-适应平衡；并分析 adapter 合并，证明合并模型在每个任务上获得正边际、导出最优混合系数，给出免训练的合并规则。

关键数字：理论推导给出合并模型每任务正边际与跨任务边际最大化的最优混合系数闭式解。

为什么值得看：首次给 LoRA 两大经验性质以统一理论解释，附带免训练合并规则，直接服务多任务 adapter 组合。

原文：A Margin Perspective on LoRA: Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting and Adapter Merging

item.title: XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. After a one-time calibration step on a small labeled calibration set of as few as 30 samples, our attack requires only a single query for each target sample. Unlike prior label-only attacks requiring iterative queries or shadow training, our method relies solely on the predicted label and its accompanying explanation. Our evaluation indicates that XposedMIA achieves …

item.title: Why Kubernetes Cannot Contain a Full Lazy-Pulling Cache: Two Impossibility Results and a Bounded, Honest Design for Model Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Lazy container-image pulling makes cold starts of autoscaled model-serving fleets on Kubernetes nearly independent of model size, but it moves the model's bytes into a node-level cache that the platform neither bounds nor accounts for. This article establishes, by experiment, two impossibility results for that cache. A monitoring-side remedy cannot catch its failure: a sentinel readiness probe stays green while 272 of 280 files are unreadable. A platform-side remedy cannot contain it: kubelet, given full disk-pressure visibility, frees 0 bytes and evicts 26 bystander pods, because its reclamation actuator is keyed to an accounting that does not know the cache exists. The article then eliminates the failure class inside the component that owns the bytes, with no change to kubelet or the container runtime interface, by two design rules: a byte budget whose pressure signal is keyed to filesystem truth, so that a never-blocking, lossy accounting still enforces a hard bound (held against about 301,000 dropped updates), and pass-through semantics under which a failed cache write never becomes a failed read, with the coupling traced to a single io.MultiWriter. item.title: Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. This perspective makes trajectory compatibility the central criterion for reference selection in multi-turn OPD. Experiments on ALFWorld and the airline domain of $τ^3$-bench show that LCS is the only evaluated reference selector to improve over reference-free OPD on both ALFWorld overall scores and all three airline metrics. item.title: When Does Physics Beat Data? Data-Efficient Traffic State Estimation with Amortized PINNs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Traffic state estimation (TSE) reconstructs traffic density at unmonitored locations from a sparse set of sensors. Data-driven models work well when sensors are dense but degrade sharply as coverage thins. We show that imposing the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards conservation law as a physics-informed prior makes TSE more data-efficient. On four real corridors (NGSIM, I-80, PeMS04, PeMS08), physics-informed estimators generalise to held-out sensors where data-driven models, including classical and deep kriging, overfit the observed ones. On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

item.title: When Are Predictions Enough? An Evaluation Protocol for Frozen Expert Composition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Practitioners often combine independently trained models while keeping their weights frozen. These experts are commonly combined through their final predictions, although their internal features may retain useful information that those predictions omit. We ask when combining features improves on combining predictions, and how to make that comparison fair. We introduce a reusable evaluation protocol, apply it to 21 frozen deepfake detectors from DF40 (Yan et al., 2024), and audit how evaluation choices change the conclusions. The protocol uses strong prediction baselines, compares simple and larger feature combiners, varies architecture and training data separately, and reports results by held-out generator with train/test overlap controls. Under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, logistic regression on the features of six architecture-diverse experts improves macro AUROC by 0.081 over the best tested prediction combiner in each fold, with gains on seven of eight generators. The larger network shows no clear improvement over the linear model (approximately 3.5M versus 10K parameters), suggesting that access to richer information matters more than additional combiner capacity on thi…

item.title: What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低精度预训练通常以验证损失评判，但验证损失匹配时，罕见事实的学习效率是否也一致？论文用受控曝光次数的合成传记数据，从零训练模拟 4-bit 矩阵乘法的 transformer，检验低精度格式的真实代价。

方法 对比 NVFP4 与 BF16 在相同验证损失下的罕见事实召回所需曝光次数；进一步用零均值梯度噪声分解量化代价来源，并测试提高学习率能否补偿。

关键数字 NVFP4 需 1.32× 与 1.52× 曝光次数才达到 BF16 的召回（验证损失仅差 0.5% 与 2%）；主读数下曝光代价约 1.2×；BF16 checkpoint 的梯度统计可无拟合排序各格式代价（Spearman 0.96）。

为什么值得看 提示仅看损失曲线会高估低精度预训练，罕见事实习得应作为独立指标纳入评测。

item.title: Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rat…

item.title: UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Accurate prediction of electronic Hamiltonians would enable broad property inference while avoiding the high computational cost of Density Functional Theory (DFT). However, progress toward general-purpose materials foundation models is limited by a data bottleneck: existing Hamiltonian datasets are typically small, lack structural diversity, and often omit essential relativistic physics such as spin--orbit coupling (SOC). We therefore construct UniHam, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset and benchmark suite comprising 100,000+ DFT-computed complex-valued Hermitian Hamiltonians with full SOC, covering 72 elements and a wide range of crystal geometries and symmetries (spanning diverse lattice types and space-group families). Building on UniHam, we benchmark two representative state-of-the-art models under a standardized protocol and introduce complementary evaluation metrics that jointly assess three dimensions: (i) Hamiltonian reconstruction accuracy, (ii) out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization across composition/symmetry shifts, and (iii) the ability to support downstream property prediction from the predicted Hamiltonians. item.title: Two-Tier Task Offloading for Satellite-Assisted Marine Networks: A Hybrid Stackelberg-Bargaining Game Approach
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The proliferation of maritime activities has spurred the emergence of numerous computation-intensive and delay-sensitive marine applications and services. Given the inherent rationality, selfish nature, and limited computational abilities of marine devices, devising effective strategies to incentivize their participation in task processing become a critical challenge. In this paper, we investigate the satellite-assisted marine multi-access edge computing (MEC) and propose a two-tier task offloading scheme through a hybrid Stackelberg-Bargaining game approach to enhance offloading efficiency and maximize the utility of marine devices. Specifically, for the underwater acoustic communication, we consider the scenario where multiple autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), managed by maritime autonomous surface ships (MASSs), upload their collected data using non-orthogonal multiple access(NOMA) to optimize channel utilization.
