item.title: Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We introduce Rapid Simulation Based Inference (RSBI), a diffusion-based variational approach to likelihood-free Bayesian inference that achieves high sampling efficiency under large prior-to-posterior volumes. RSBI builds on advances in Schrödinger Bridge (SB) diffusion sampling to handle multi-modal posteriors, with an initial likelihood supplied by a distance measure via a differentiable simulator. The key innovation of this initial surrogate likelihood is that it gives a highly efficient proposal distribution, replacing sequential rounds of other methods with an efficient one-shot proposal. Subsequent refinement then transports the proposal to the true posterior as specified by the simulator and the original prior. The SB sampler is warm-started from the proposal, and its energy is corrected by a neural likelihood ratio that is learned only where the proposal places mass. As a variational method, RSBI does not suffer from prior leakage commonly observed in standard sequential posterior estimation methods. To improve mode coverage we optionally utilize the well-tempered meta-dynamics framework, which also encourages exploration of the prior volume. We observe strong performance o…

item.title: Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 一个模型接管另一模型的对话通常须重读全部历史；KV cache 翻译把源 cache 映射成目标自身格式，使目标从完整上下文继续而无需重读——对 GQA 已可行，但开源前沿模型如今缓存压缩潜变量（MLA）、稀疏注意力索引器 key 与定长线性注意力状态。

方法 复现 KV-Lingo 于 GQA 对，再为每类对象给出捕获/注入位置与达到原生质量的机制：MLA 潜变量用逐 token 线性映射翻译；循环状态用闭式校正复制或用目标自身循环重放合成；研究 16–48B 规模两个混合对的双向翻译（Kimi-VL-A3B ↔ Kimi-Linear-48B、Qwen3.5-27B ↔ Qwen3.8-27B）加稀疏注意力目标。

关键数字 从源层 0 MLA 潜变量解码 token id 使 needle 召回从 0.09 升至 2–32K 的 0.99、64K 的 0.83–1.00（最长训练 prompt 的 8 倍）；混合全 MLA 方向每个任务指标都在原生质量配对置信区间内；64K token 时首 token 时间比重读短 18.7x 与 46.8x。

为什么值得看 把 KV 翻译从 GQA 推进到 MLA/线性注意力/稀疏索引器混合架构，为模型间无缝交接对话提供完整配方。

item.title: Train High, Ship Low: Efficient LoRA Synchronization for Distributed On-Policy Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Transmitting LoRA adapters to rollout workers can bottleneck distributed on-policy post-training over bandwidth-constrained networks. Lowering the training rank may limit the capacity a workload needs, while adaptive optimizer updates are difficult to compress. Rollout workers can instead reconstruct updates from gradients by maintaining replicated optimizer states. We introduce HiLo, a compressor-agnostic framework that replaces parameter transmission with compressed gradient dissemination and local optimizer replay. By applying the same decoded gradients, the learner and workers maintain consistent policy states at the same version under reproducible execution. We further develop Spar, a budget-aware gradient compressor that combines spectral truncation, adaptive rank allocation and error feedback to decouple training rank from communication cost. Experiments across on-policy distillation and reward-guided post-training show that HiLo with Spar maintains learning quality close to full synchronization while transmitting as little as 1.6% of the adapter bytes, and accelerates end-to-end updates by up to $2.2\times$ under bandwidth constraints.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: To SIMD or Not to SIMD: Comparing RVV vs. CGRA SoCs for Non-Linear Functions in AI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 非线性函数是 LLM 中的重要操作类别，但芯片厂商一直用传统向量/标量单元处理，其性能跟不上几乎所有厂商都配备的矩阵乘单元（MMU）；FPGA/CGRA 等可重构单元缺乏与 MMU 搭配的传统单元的系统比较。

方法 构建两个 SoC：RVV 向量处理器 SoC 与延迟不敏感（elastic）CGRA SoC，均配 MMU 与单核 CPU 驱动；为常见前馈网络提出映射，系统对比两类方案。

关键数字 CGRA 在简单逐点非线性（如 SiLU）激活阶段相对 RVV 最高快 7.12x 时钟周期；RVV 在复杂非线性（如 softmax）上相对 CGRA 最高快 9.8x；在完整前馈块上对应最大值分别为 3.16x 与 4.24x。

为什么值得看 首次系统对比 RVV 与 CGRA 处理非线性函数的差异，结论「简单函数 CGRA、复杂函数 SIMD」对 AI SoC 单元选型有直接参考。

item.title: TSFFormer: A Frequency-Domain Spike Transformer for Green Human Activity Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enable pervasive Human Activity Recognition (HAR), but traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) suffer from an "arithmetic-latency deadlock" due to dense floating-point MAC operations. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer ultra-low power, existing ones face spatial blind spots, rigid neurons, and gradient degradation. To address these, we propose TSFFormer, a purely spiking Fourier Transformer for Green HAR. It introduces two key innovations: (1) a MultiHeadFourier attention that performs frequency-domain global mixing, reducing complexity from \(O(V^2)\) to \(O(V\log V)\), eliminating spatial blind spots, and saving \(\sim\)50% GPU memory; and (2) a dual-compartment Temporal Spiking LIF (TSLIFNode) that utilizes dynamic thresholds to adapt to non-stationary rhythms and mitigate gradient degradation. Extensive experiments on 8 public IMU benchmarks demonstrate that TSFFormer surpasses state-of-the-art SNNs and even the classic DeepConvLSTM, achieving a \(\sim\)3\(\times\) faster training speed with an energy footprint of 0.1 pJ. Ablation studies confirm the synergistic effect of our modules, providing a highly accurate, ultra-low-powe…

item.title: Structured Kernel Surrogate Models for Multimodal Attribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We study the problem of cross-sample modality attribution, which involves measuring how one modality in one sample affects the learning outcome in other multimodal samples. This problem is crucial in a multimodal system because a data modality (such as a text description) may be redundant for one sample (a self-explanatory image), but the same data modality would otherwise be uniquely informative for another sample, or informative when combined with other modalities. Prior work focuses on influence estimation at the level of one sample, and it remains an open question how one should capture the interactions across both samples and modalities. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuning large-scale foundation models across resource-constrained, distributed clients presents significant computational and communication challenges. While merging Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with Federated Learning (FL) enables rank-based flexibility, the interdependence of the adaptation matrices ($\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$) often complicates optimization. In this work, we theoretically demonstrate that LoRA fine-tuning with Gaussian initialization and a frozen $\mathbf{A}$ matrix acts as a stochastic approximation of full fine-tuning, where batch gradients are subject to a random, rank-dependent perturbation. Motivated by this insight, we propose freezing and periodically resampling $\mathbf{A}$ matrices at the client level. This strategy decouples the $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ gradients, diminishes LoRA low-rank constraints and reduces both computational and uplink communication overheads by 50\%, allowing for the reallocation of resources toward higher adaptation ranks. item.title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised…

item.title: Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at this https URL.

item.title: ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Sequence-to-function models such as AlphaGenome and Borzoi read up to a megabase of DNA and score a genetic variant by comparing their predictions for the reference and alternate sequences. Insertions and deletions (indels) are costly to score, because an indel usually shifts the unchanged DNA after it onto a different pooling grid, which prevents direct reuse of the reference's encoder activations. The AlphaGenome Atlas scored more than 100 million indels with three full model passes each, although the DNA after an indel matches the reference shifted by the indel's length. We present ShiftCache, an exact reuse system that encodes each shifted reference once and shares it among all variants scored in the same window with the same shift. ShiftCache copies every encoder output a variant can reuse and recomputes the rest in batched tiles. On held-out AlphaGenome windows shared by many indels, in strict fp32 on one A6000, ShiftCache is 3.5 to 6.5$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution and 1.6 to 2.7$\times$ faster than our adaptation of layer-by-layer reuse to indels. It is 3.5 to 4.1$\times$ faster than dense reimplementations of two published analyses with Borzoi and AlphaG…

item.title: Shaping Useful Noise: Energy Distributions Predict Visual Pretraining Quality
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Synthetic data can scale visual pretraining, but current selection criteria only partially explain which datasets train strong representations. We propose using the energy profile of a dataset--the distribution of log-probability levels it occupies under a normalised real-image density model--as an audit and curation principle for synthetic data. To operationalise this view, we introduce Energy-Level Distribution Distance (ELD), which compares real and synthetic energy distributions. Real images span sparse high-likelihood scenes and dense low-likelihood textures, so useful synthetic data should cover this energy range rather than collapse to likely but low-variation samples. Across diverse synthetic datasets, ELD exposes mismatches missed by FID and predicts pretraining performance beyond FID, LPIPS variation, and feature-space recall, including across CNN and ViT self-supervised settings. We then use ELD to resample and mix synthetic sources, matching the real-image energy histogram while preserving diversity and improving downstream transfer.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs. item.title: Scale-Invariant Empirical-Bayes Laplace Approximation for ReLU Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

ReLU networks are well-known to have continuous scale symmetries; infinitely many reparameterized weight vectors that represent the same function. Dinh et al. (2017) have shown that, by reparameterizing, the geometry of the loss landscape (e.g., curvature) of these networks can be changed arbitrarily without affecting the underlying function. Thus, any quantity that depends on the network's geometry should be defined with care. In this paper, we show that the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace's approximation is not well-defined for ReLU networks, mainly due to Hessian dependence in computing the marginal likelihood, which is not invariant under ReLU scale symmetries. Thus, we can get different prior precisions, posterior covariances, and predictive uncertainties for a network having identical predictions under ReLU scaling. We define family of prior precision fields indexed by $\gamma$ and introduce $\gamma$-canonicalization, which first converts the network to its canonical representation by balancing the ratio of incoming to outgoing weights, and then fits the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace to the canonical representation. item.title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Large materials design spaces often contain rare high-performing configurations that are difficult to identify through trial-and-error exploration or purely representative machine-learning (ML) sampling. In this work, we present FruBO, a flexible Bayesian Optimization framework for accelerating the discovery of optimal configurations in computationally demanding materials design problems. As a case study, we investigate multilayer Moiré patterns generated by the superposition of six rotated hexagonal lattices, where the objective is to identify the rotational conformation that maximizes pore-size uniformity, quantified using the Jain fairness index. The resulting benchmark contains 600,000 unique configurations and exhibits a highly skewed objective distribution, making the global optimum difficult to locate by random sampling. We compare random exploration, Gaussian Process-based Bayesian Optimization, and Bayesian Optimization using a lightweight CatBoost surrogate with committee-based uncertainty estimation. Random sampling identifies the global optimum only after 533,012 evaluations, requiring approximately 31 hours, while Gaussian Process-based BO becomes impractical due to GP…

item.title: SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：per-step 模型路由器为 agent 的每次 LLM 调用动态选最优模型，但每次切换都丢弃前缀缓存复用（KV 缓存按模型隔离，新模型须重新 prefill）——如何让切换不再付全量 prefill 代价？

方法：SHADOWPREFILL 在路由器未选中的模型上预填会话上下文，利用正常流量实例的空闲容量，使下次切换时前缀已缓存。它收割在途请求的每迭代 SLO 余量、保护被路由调用、把影子 KV 溢写到宿主内存，影子不完整时回退冷切换。

关键数字：生产 coding-agent 轨迹（平均上下文 63K token）下，切换后前缀命中率从 80-89% 掉到 44-65%、切换调用慢 1.5-3.2×；SHADOWPREFILL 用 LLMRouter 路由 24 对模型，切换调用延迟降 8.5-21.4%、LLM 调用延迟降 3.7-17.7%、路由 token 成本降 22.5-46.1%，正常流量 SLO 与每请求能耗基本不变（+0.4%）。

为什么值得看：agentic 服务里模型路由的隐藏成本被系统化解决，复用空闲算力换缓存命中，收益明确。

原文：SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving

item.title: Resetting-based designated information distribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

For a network of $n$ nodes under random gossip dynamics, we show that by introducing the additional resetting mechanism (with rate $β$) to a designated subset of $r$ nodes, the expected sum of all node values is asymptotically equal to $\tfrac{n}{r}$ times the sum of the initial values of the $r$ designated nodes, in the small-$β$ and long-time limit. We also analyze the convergence speed to this asymptotic state and provide an approximate high-probability confidence interval for the expected sum at finite time $t$ and finite $β$. Operationally, we propose a protocol that distributes the initial node values over the designated subset evenly (up to a prescribed precision), by appropriately turning on and off the resetting dynamics. Our work not only offers insights into classical problems such as distributed computing and network control, but also serves as a potential foundation for designing quantum algorithms that prepare desired states in quantum networks using only local operations.

item.title: Release Sooner, Expose Less: Offloading MoE Dispatch in NCCL-EP under Dual-Batch Overlap
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 双微批重叠（DBO）把 MoE 通信藏到另一微批计算之后，但只有 dispatch 发送释放 GPU 后才生效——dispatch 发送占用 GPU 的时间因此暴露，而释放后的网络推进可被隐藏。

方法 在 NCCL-EP 上评估三种针对暴露通信时间的研究配置：GPI（GPU 构造 GPU-Friendly Descriptors 并提交到 NIC 可访问内存传输）、GPI-MC（单个 GFD 描述 MoE token 扇出）、GDAKI Free Flow（把发送推进移到主机线程）。

关键数字 GB300 NVL72 上三种方法在多数参数扫描工作点降低 dispatch-send 时间；send 与 receive 间插入 32–512 微秒计算可隐藏延迟推进；分离式 vLLM serving 中相对 NCCL-EP 默认 GDAKI 中位 TPOT 降 15–25%，相对 DeepEP v1 降 16–42%。

为什么值得看 聚焦 DBO 下被忽视的 dispatch 暴露时间，给出三种可落地的 offload 方案与量化收益。

方法 在 NCCL-EP 上评估三种针对暴露通信时间的研究配置：GPI（GPU 构造 GPU-Friendly Descriptors 并提交到 NIC 可访问内存传输）、GPI-MC（单个 GFD 描述 MoE token 扇出）、GDAKI Free Flow（把发送推进移到主机线程）。

关键数字 GB300 NVL72 上三种方法在多数参数扫描工作点降低 dispatch-send 时间；send 与 receive 间插入 32–512 微秒计算可隐藏延迟推进；分离式 vLLM serving 中相对 NCCL-EP 默认 GDAKI 中位 TPOT 降 15–25%，相对 DeepEP v1 降 16–42%。

为什么值得看 聚焦 DBO 下被忽视的 dispatch 暴露时间，给出三种可落地的 offload 方案与量化收益。

item.title: RecoGEM: A Serving System for Production-Scale Generative Recommendation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Generative recommendation (GR) is moving industrial recommender systems (RecSys) from scoring candidate items to autoregressively generating item identifiers. This shift promises higher recommendation quality, but makes serving substantially harder: each request executes a short sequence of dependent decoding steps that explore a large item space and select promising candidates on the latency-critical path. GR not only creates structural mismatches with conventional RecSys pipelines, but also challenges the architectural and optimization assumptions of LLM serving stacks, making direct adoption of existing systems difficult. We present RecoGEM, our production GR serving system. RecoGEM uses a runtime--engine decoupling architecture to move GR-specific serving responsibilities, such as candidate-state transitions and live artifact updates, to a dedicated runtime. Its execution engine exploits GR's short token sequences, large candidate populations, and predictable step shapes to optimize self-attention, candidate selection, and execution planning. item.title: Prediction-Powered LLM Ranking with Adaptively Collected Human Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Ranking large language models (LLMs) through human evaluations is essential for downstream decision-making. Because human feedback is expensive, evaluation platforms often collect it adaptively, prioritizing informative model comparisons using previously observed feedback. To further improve precision with limited human feedback, evaluators can draw on abundant unrated responses and relatively inexpensive LLM judges; however, judge bias and adaptive dependence challenge standard i.i.d. inference frameworks. We propose Prediction-Powered Ranking (PP-Rank), a framework that combines LLM-judge predictions with human feedback to improve precision while providing valid inference under adaptive sampling. Data-driven prediction weights minimize the asymptotic covariance trace within the proposed class. In theory, we establish asymptotic normality for general evaluation targets and simultaneous ranking inference. A joint martingale analysis handles dependence between adaptive human feedback and auxiliary data. item.title: PegasusAI Studio: Legible Cyberinfrastructure and Accountable AI Agents for Scientific Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

AI coding agents can now construct scientific workflows, but operating them on shared cyberinfrastructure (CI) raises problems that code generation does not solve. Agents need current knowledge of the workflow system and its execution sites and access to the runtime state of distributed executions, while facilities need to attribute every agent action to a user and bound it by that user's privileges. We present PegasusAI Studio, an AI-assisted science gateway built on the Pegasus and HTCondor stack. Studio makes CI legible to agents by projecting one facility-curated knowledge base into the native configuration of several coding agents, by introspecting workflow interfaces and execution sites, and by grounding diagnosis in workflow and scheduler telemetry. Agent actions operate within a trust envelope that combines federated authentication, per-user execution environments and scheduler credentials, provider-neutral model access, observability, and approval controls for state-changing actions. The same application runs as a JupyterHub-based gateway on a research cloud and as an Open OnDemand application on HPC systems. We evaluate Studio through case studies of legacy CASA weather w…

item.title: Pairwise distortion distribution for compression and quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Choosing the latent dimension is a critical challenge in data compression, where conventional hyperparameter optimization is costly and ad hoc. Intrinsic dimension provides a good alternative, which connects information-theoretic notions such as Renyi information dimension (RID) to rate-distortion dimension and random codebook compression. In this work, we introduce the pairwise distortion distribution (PDD) and its asymptotic limit, pairwise dimension (PD), which generalize the correlation integral to general distortion measures. We show that PD bounds RID, and PDD provides a lower bound for random codebook quantization performance, which can guide a practical use for compression, quantization, and dimensionality reduction applications.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OverlapAdvisor: Modeling and Adapting Computation-Communication Overlap for Distributed MoE Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 专家并行（EP）的 MoE 推理依赖 All-to-All 通信，计算-通信重叠策略至关重要，但没有任何策略普遍最优——103 个生产配置、不同输入长度与四类硬件上，最快策略随模型形状、EP 度、输入长度与硬件变化。

方法 提出 OverlapAdvisor：用两种粒度建模重叠阶段以刻画计算-通信依赖，构建统一性能模型（计入峰值计算/内存/通信性能的偏差），支持两个 serving 引擎内的启动时、配置感知策略选择。

关键数字 四个 MoE 模型（30B–235B）对三个基线：内核级平均 1.16x、最高 1.59x 加速，预测 MAPE 3.3%–15.9%；SGLang/vLLM 端到端吞吐最高提升 31.7%；对 DeepEP-v1 与 FlashMoE 的中位加速分别为 1.10x 与 1.22x。

为什么值得看 用数据证明「无普遍最优」并给出配置感知选择模型，直接提升生产 MoE serving 的吞吐。

item.title: Optimal Proximity Black Hole Search with Programmable Matter
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The concept of programmable matter (PM) envisions objects composed of tiny, mobile particles capable of self-arrangement, which allows them to change shape, color, and move. We initiate the study of the Black Hole Search problem within the context of PM. The problem involves a dangerous and unnoticeable location, the black hole, that, without a trace, destroys any particle visiting it. In our setting, particles move inside a convex area embedded in a triangular grid, where one vertex is a black hole. The objective is for the particles to identify a restricted set of vertices containing the black hole while ensuring that at least one particle survives. We present an algorithm utilizing three particles capable of assuming just two colors to identify the dangerous region where the black hole resides. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this algorithm is Pareto optimal in terms of number of particles and number of colors required, and asymptotically optimal in terms of number of epochs, where an epoch refers to the minimal time window within which each particle completed an activation cycle at least once.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. item.title: One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts Inference over NVLink
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 推理每层需要两次 all-to-all（dispatch 与 combine），推理时每 GPU 处理 token 少，小批量下不随 token 数增长的固定开销主导延迟——如何消除这些固定成本？

方法：提出 NVLinkOneSided 单边 EP all-to-all（限单 NVLink 域内 GPU）：源 rank 不先交换元数据即把 token 推入目标 GPU 的 rank-major 缓冲区，grouped GEMM 原地读取而非逐专家拷贝。提供 Fence 与 Sentinel 两种同步协议，分别面向高吞吐与低延迟场景；模块化接口，与量化格式无关、与计算后端解耦。

关键数字：Blackwell GPU 上 dispatch+combine 比 DeepEP 快 1.2-3.0×（小批量下增益最大）；MoE 层整体比 DeepEP+DeepGEMM 快 2.4×；每 GPU 128 token 内甚至超过融合版 DeepGEMM MegaMoE，解码场景仍具竞争力。

为什么值得看：小批量 MoE 推理的通信范式改进，直接降低解码延迟，接口设计易于集成进推理框架。

原文：One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts Inference over NVLink

item.title: One-Shot Federated Graph Learning via High-Fidelity Proxies and Transferability-Guided Collaboration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

One-shot Federated Graph Learning (OFGL) has emerged as a communication-efficient paradigm for federated graph learning under strict bandwidth constraints, compressing collaboration into a single transmission round. Nevertheless, this extreme setting suffers from a fundamental Single-Transmission Bottleneck, which limits both the quality and utility of exchanged knowledge. First, while existing methods attempt to distill private graphs into shareable proxies, their aggressive one-shot compression inherently triggers a fidelity crisis. This compression distorts local graph topology and semantics across clients, leading to externalized knowledge underexpression. Second, although the server aggregates these proxies to update global models, current integration schemes suffer from transferability agnosticism. The server cannot reliably identify cross-client collaboration potential, thus resulting in integrated knowledge underutilization. To tackle these dual challenges, we propose FedHFT, an effective One-Shot Personalized Federated Graph Learning (OPFGL) framework that addresses this bottleneck from two perspectives, namely High-Fidelity Knowledge Externalization and Transferability-Wa…

item.title: Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN for Efficient Multipath Parameter Estimation in MIMO Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

High-resolution multipath estimation in wideband multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channels requires repeated searches over angle of arrival, angle of departure, and propagation distance. This paper presents neural network-assisted CLEAN (NN-CLEAN), which replaces the multidimensional search at each extraction step with a multi-head classifier while retaining least-squares (LS) estimation of the complex path gain, parametric reconstruction, and residual cancellation. The same classifier is applied to successive residuals, allowing the extraction depth to vary without changing its output structure. With the number of iterations prescribed by the reference multipath-component (MPC) count, off-grid synthetic tests show that NN-CLEAN slightly exceeds grid-search CLEAN (GS-CLEAN) in path accuracy for one and two MPCs, although its accuracy declines more rapidly at larger path counts. For complete three-MPC extraction at a batch size of eight, NN-CLEAN achieves an approximately $27\times$ speedup and a $52$-fold reduction in peak GPU memory relative to GS-CLEAN. Applied without retraining to two-MPC line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) Sionna ray-tracing channels within a…

item.title: NearFormer: Linear-Size Sparse Attention via Randomized Near Neighbors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 图 transformer 能捕捉长程交互，但二次方注意力成本限制其在大图上的应用。

方法 提出 NearFormer：全局注意力被限制在随机近邻（NN）图上——用高效随机化构造把每个节点连接到由标签无关特征或谱几何定义的更广邻域中的少数近邻；固定保留预算 k 下注意力支撑规模为线性 O(|E|+nk)；NN 图经桶内搜索构建一次后固定，边用作稀疏全局注意力支撑（可选学习注意力偏置），原图保留用于局部消息传递。

关键数字 长程图基准与合成结构任务上，相对局部消息传递、密集与稀疏注意力呈现有利的准确率-可扩展性权衡（摘要未给具体量化数字）。

为什么值得看 用随机近邻把图 transformer 注意力降到线性规模，兼顾长程建模与可扩展性。

关键数字 长程图基准与合成结构任务上，相对局部消息传递、密集与稀疏注意力呈现有利的准确率-可扩展性权衡（摘要未给具体量化数字）。

为什么值得看 用随机近邻把图 transformer 注意力降到线性规模，兼顾长程建模与可扩展性。

item.title: Mitigating SM-Level Load Imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting on GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic, real-time rendering on commodity GPUs and is increasingly adopted in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators. However, existing optimizations rely on algorithmic changes that often require retraining, or on specialized accelerators that lack flexibility across evolving 3DGS variants. In this paper, we identify a fundamental inefficiency in GPU-based 3DGS rendering: severe SM-level load imbalance caused by uneven workloads across screen tiles. This imbalance creates a long execution tail, leaving most SMs idle while a few process computationally intensive tiles, particularly in large-scale urban scenes. To address this, we present a software-defined GPU scheduling approach that mitigates the execution tail. Our approach uses a persistent kernel to schedule heavy tiles first and selectively chunks outlier tiles across multiple CTAs. A lightweight per-frame policy determines when and how much to chunk using tile statistics already available in the rendering pipeline. Our approach requires neither retraining nor specialized hardware and can be applied orthogonally to existing optimizations across diverse 3DGS varian…

item.title: MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying machine learning models in high stakes scientific applications, yet methods that flag OOD inputs without retraining the model have been validated almost exclusively on image classification. We introduce MOOD (Materials Out-of-Distribution Detection), a benchmark for evaluating whether these post-hoc OOD detectors transfer to graph neural networks (GNNs) on materials property prediction. MOOD evaluates 15 post-hoc detectors and 2 supervised diagnostic probes across 4 GNN architectures, 5 MatBench tasks, and 15 physically motivated compositional and structural shifts, yielding 264 evaluation settings and over 13,000 AUROC measurements across three encoder training seeds. Our evaluation reveals three key findings. First, current post-hoc detectors perform near chance; all 15 detectors achieve an AUROC around 0.5. Second, detector failures decompose into two regimes: method bottlenecks and encoder bottlenecks. Method bottlenecks arise when supervised probes can separate in-distribution (ID) from OOD samples but unsupervised detectors fail, meaning that the embeddings contain OOD signal that current detectors do not extract.…

item.title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：循环语言模型不增加参数加深计算，但跨层跨轮缓存全上下文 KV 严重限制服务批大小——如何在不增加每轮 KV 的前提下获得循环深度？

方法：设计循环因果编码器-解码器（CED）：循环必须放在 encoder 以迭代精炼全局 KV 表示（而非重读静态 decoder 投影）；在随机循环深度下训练 encoder 循环，诱导不动点均衡——每轮无损共享上一轮 KV 缓存。

关键数字：Looped CED 匹配非循环 CED 的最小内存占用，以 1/6 的全局 KV 恢复循环 Transformer 增益的 86-93%；552B 的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 循环 8 轮跑在单 4×GB200 节点上，每 token KV 少 36.8×，可容纳 38 个 128K token 请求（与非循环模型相同），8K prompt 吞吐高 3.6×。

为什么值得看：把循环深度的 KV 成本压到零，循环模型从学术概念走向生产级服务规模的关键一步。

原文：Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders

item.title: Learning to Select Sparse Linear Solvers with Convolutional Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We investigate convolutional-neural-network (CNN) based automatic solver selection for sparse linear systems, a problem of practical importance where solver performance varies dramatically with matrix sparsity structure. A CNN is trained to regress log timing ratios between candidate solvers using spy plot images of matrix nonzero structure as input, achieving strong prediction accuracy on both held-out SuiteSparse matrices and real-world matrices from high-performance simulation codes.

item.title: Late but Valuable: Why Deadlines Change the Measured Value of LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) increasingly plan and run experiments in automated laboratories. These experiments keep running while the model reasons and run on schedules with hard deadlines. If an LLM-generated answer arrives late, the system executes a safe fallback action instead, such as rejecting a sample. This creates a systems problem that standard serving metrics do not capture. An answer that matches the fallback adds no value, and answers that differ from the fallback may require more reasoning time. Reporting answer quality and latency separately can therefore overstate the value of reasoning. We test this on synthetic sample decisions, where the best choice is known exactly and a runtime enforces the deadline. We compare one LLM's fast mode, which answers directly, with its thinking mode, which reasons first. In a prespecified replay of 1,200 new decisions, thinking answers that missed a deadline were worth about five times as much as on-time ones. Multiplying the on-time rate by the mean answer value predicted about twice the value that thinking delivered. This prediction overstated thinking's advantage over fast mode by 0.0241 per decision, and by 0.0191 in a repeat on…

item.title: LBSNet: Lightweight Brain State Modeling via Learnable Spectral Prototypes for EEG-Based Fatigue Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

EEG-based fatigue detection requires modeling spectral information across bands and its temporal variation. Recent methods combine multi-band modeling with adaptive temporal processing, yet how spectral structure across bands should influence the contribution of each temporal interval remains insufficiently explored. We propose LBSNet, a lightweight network that uses prototype-based brain-state modeling to link local spectral structure with temporal aggregation. LBSNet extracts compact multi-band features through band-specific temporal convolution, shared spatial projections, and cross-band recalibration. Within each window, relative spectral activity is encoded as a normalized descriptor and softly matched to learnable spectral prototypes. Prototype assignments and learned prototype importance jointly determine temporal weights for power aggregation, allowing the spectral pattern of each window to guide its contribution to the prediction. Subject-independent experiments on SEED-VIG and SADT show that LBSNet outperforms seven baselines while maintaining low computational cost. Ablation and visualization analyses support prototype-guided temporal weighting, while the learned prototy…

item.title: KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm…

item.title: KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Nonseparable costs and coupled constraints in distributed online convex optimization often arise when system performance and operational constraints depend on the joint configuration of all agents and cannot be decomposed into individual contributions. Such nonseparability leads to fully distributed decision-making with challenging partial local information, where each agent evaluates its local primal-dual update using estimated global information via a local belief of the joint action and the shared Lagrange multiplier to be exchanged with neighbors. While the belief consensus established by prior works ensures no-regret learning, exchanging beliefs comprising full-dimensional primal and dual states at every round imposes a communication overhead that scales with both the joint decision dimension and the network size. Existing event-triggered schemes typically activate communication according to state variation or consensus error. Under nonseparable coupling, however, errors of equal magnitude can produce markedly different perturbations after passing through the KKT operator. We therefore propose a randomized KKT-perturbation-aware communication mechanism, where the triggering of…

item.title: K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Self-recurrence represents an important component for temporal processing in neural networks, both artificial and biological, where it appears naturally in the form of leaky integration. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies of the gradient, an efficient and effective method of online training is still lacking. Here we propose K-prop, a novel online learning method for leaky neural networks. It dramatically reduces the computational and memory cost of real time recurrent learning (RTRL) by propagating kernel gains. K-prop also outperforms existing RTRL approximations and achieves performance comparable to backpropagation through time in sequence learning, classification, and reinforcement learning tasks. We further analyze how its sole approximation affects gradient quality and identify conditions under which K-prop remains accurate and effective.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and…

item.title: IC-GNN: Modeling Individualized Brain Community Organization for Disease Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Brain networks exhibit modular organization, where community structures vary substantially across individuals and diseases. Understanding these individual differences is crucial for advancing both basic neuroscience research and precision medicine. However, widely used predefined group-level brain atlases often overlook this heterogeneity. While individualized functional parcellations capture subject-specific variability in community boundaries, they often require lengthy scan times to achieve fine-grained resolution and complicate cross-subject comparisons. To address this trade-off and investigate how individualized community organization captures disease-associated changes across individuals, we propose IC-GNN, an atlas-anchored model that forms distinct, individualized functional communities directly over atlas-defined brain regions. IC-GNN derives discrete, individualized multiscale communities from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, refines community-guided connections, and adapts shared regional weights to each subject's community context to enable both individualized modeling and group-level comparisons. item.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Privacy-Enhanced Computing Through Register Renaming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Privacy-Enhanced Computing (PEC) is a mechanism to hide program secrets from the outside world without paying the cost of fully-homomorphic encryption. Previous work has developed hardware mechanisms to achieve this goal but they require a dedicated processor enclave where all computations are done, requiring duplicate ALU resources and limiting the performance of PEC-utilizing applications due to not being able to access the full compute resources of the processor (e.g., multiple execution units and vector units), or not being able to execute PEC instructions in parallel and out-of-order. In this work, we introduce HPS-PEC (Hidden in Plain Sight PEC), a novel method of utilizing existing infrastructure in the CPU to achieve PEC with minor modifications to the architecture. We show that, across 25 VIP-Bench benchmarks and with a 7-cycle QARMA-64 cipher, HPS-PEC runs encrypted code at 3.41x the execution time of unprotected native code (geometric mean), of which 1.03x is the cost of data-oblivious code itself, and is 1.26x faster than a Sequestered Encryption (SE) unit while utilizing under a third of its dedicated area. Our method keeps plaintext out of reach of every instruction, …

item.title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Federated Unsupervised Visual Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) is a promising research paradigm that enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without data sharing. To handle unlabeled data in local clients, existing unsupervised FL research has primarily focused on tasks like clustering and self-supervised representation learning, leaving the critical problem of unsupervised visual recognition largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce FedUR, the first framework designed for unsupervised recognition by leveraging the zero-shot capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP. Specifically, FedUR addresses data heterogeneity through a pseudo-labeling mechanism with a class-aware data selection strategy. This strategy first estimates a global pseudo-label distribution, then allocates pseudo-labeled data to clients accordingly. To handle the uncertainty of conventional positive pseudo-labels, FedUR further incorporates class weights and a negative pseudo-labeling strategy. Furthermore, FedUR proposes a personalized prompt aggregation protocol where general visual prompts are aggregated on the server, and personalized text prompts encoding local knowledge are retained on clients.…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: GigaEdge Spench: An SDK for Practical Streaming Speech Enhancement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：流式语音增强要同时满足 CPU 服务器、移动端与浏览器三种部署环境，如何构建一个可配置、跨平台的实用 SDK？

方法：开源 GigaEdge Spench SDK——增强通道由神经降噪、归一化、动态处理、采样率转换与回声消除模块组合而成（归一化可不带神经模型单独运行）。共享 C++ 核经原生接口支持 ONNX Runtime 与 TensorFlow Lite，提供 Android/iOS SDK 与 WebAssembly 集成；独立流共享模型资源，同流连续帧可单次推理调用处理。发布 8kHz INT8 降噪器与判别式/混合 48kHz FP32 模型。

关键数字：EARS-WHAM v2 上评测并与 RNNoise、DPDFNet2 比较；所有测试的原生与 Web 配置处理文件均快于实时。

为什么值得看：端到端可部署的流式语音增强 SDK，覆盖从嵌入式到浏览器的完整链路，含模型选择/块大小/运行环境的实证研究。

原文：GigaEdge Spench: An SDK for Practical Streaming Speech Enhancement

item.title: FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuning a deployed language model on one task after another can change behaviour that should stay fixed, such as earlier skills, general chat or refusals. Today, such forgetting is found only after training, on the benchmarks someone chose to run. This work bounds, before training, how often its outputs change on chosen prompt distributions. FireGate places each task's update, such as a new LoRA, behind a gate, which is a classifier on the model's frozen lower layers that decides for each prompt whether the update is used. Where no gate fires, the model computes exactly what the old one computes. As a result, on any prompt distribution, every bounded behaviour score changes by at most the gates' firing rate there over a whole task stream. Calibrating each gate on unlabeled prompts of what must not change fixes that rate before training, with a PAC guarantee, whatever weights training produces. Forgetting is thus bounded by the gate's false-alarm rate, and its price is the gate's power: no update, gated or not, that changes as few protected outputs can change new-task outputs more often than the best test of that level tells new-task prompts from protected ones. On reinforcement…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FP64 Performance and the Limits of Ozaki Emulation on HPC Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：业界流行叙事认为 HPC 加速器可弱化原生双精度——低精度张量核可按需仿真 FP64，且多数 HPC 负载带宽受限。这些主张是否成立？

方法：对代表性 HPC 负载（多种常见计算 motif）做 roofline 剖析，评估其算术强度与精度需求；并用 Ozaki 方法实测 FP64 仿真的可能性与局限，检验在应用规模下收益能否存活。

关键数字：Ozaki 仿真仅适用于主计算足够大、稠密且 GEMM 形状的负载子集，该子集占 HPC 生态不到 10%；即使在该有利区间，独立 GEMM 加速也不足以加速（或避免性能回退）应用——数值行为、工作区需求、矩阵形状与集成开销决定收益；稠密 GEMM 只占 HPC 负载 FP64 计算的一小部分。

为什么值得看：用实测数据给"张量核仿真 FP64"叙事划定边界，为加速器精度取舍提供依据。

原文：FP64 Performance and the Limits of Ozaki Emulation on HPC Systems

item.title: Exploiting Native Hardware Heterogeneity: Custom GPSIMD Operators for Accelerating Emerging LLM Memory on AWS Trainium
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 新兴内存模块（如 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 Engram）混合不规则整数工作（64-bit n-gram 哈希、稀疏表查找）与稠密计算（GEMM 与 gate）；GPU-FPGA 系统可拆分到不同设备加速 5.9x，但 AWS Trainium 的 GPSIMD 引擎只能通过固定内置指令调用，官方自定义算子工具链不支持 Trainium 2/3 且不能与 NKI 同用。

方法 构建工具链：为 GPSIMD 核编译 C++ 自定义算子，注入到 Trainium 3 上 NKI 内核编译出的 NEFF 中，在当前软件栈内扩展 GPSIMD 可定制性。

关键数字 相对手调 NKI 基线：两个 GPSIMD 算子在 decode 阶段把 n-gram 哈希加速 1.79x、表检索最高 4.95x、整个 Engram 计算最高 1.14x。

为什么值得看 在 Trainium 上绕过官方工具链限制、把自定义算子注入 NEFF 的方法，对利用该平台原生异构算力有直接参考价值。

item.title: Explanation-Aware Fairness Beyond Output Parity: Joint Output-Attribution Regularization for Medical Image Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Output-level fairness does not constrain whether demographic groups rely on similar predictive contributions in representation space. For a nonlinear encoder with a linear head, we show that outcome-conditioned output score disparity equals the signed sum of feature attribution differences across subgroups by allowing small prediction gaps to arise through cancellation effect. We test whether an attribution disparity penalty complements output-level equalized odds based fairness surrogates. Across 960 DINOv2-LoRA models on HAM10000 and Harvard-GF datasets for gender and race fairness, attribution augmentation increases utility-fairness trade-off performance for hypervolume in six different settings with paired 95% confidence intervals and relative gains of 1.49-10.57%. Under a predefined utility constraint, augmented model families also achieve 9.0-38.7% lower equalized odds difference, lower attribution disparity, and reduced cancellation ratio while preserving predictive utility. These results support attribution fairness as a complementary explanation-aware constraint on output fairness.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Evidence or Marginal? What Moment-Vector Propagation Computes in Polynomial Density Neurons
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

When a neuron's input is lost, or known through a belief $q$, what should it output? For a neuron storing a joint polynomial density $N$ with input density $D$, two formulas compete. $p_\mathrm{CD}=E_q[N]/E_q[D]$ costs one matrix-vector product; Hierarchical Correlation Reconstruction introduces it as a constant-denominator approximation to $p_\mathrm{EU}=E_q[N/D]$. For a density model both are exact answers to different questions: $p_\mathrm{CD}$ is Bayesian updating with the belief as virtual evidence; $p_\mathrm{EU}$ installs the belief as a new marginal (Jeffrey's rule). With a missing input $p_\mathrm{CD}$ returns the model's conditional; $p_\mathrm{EU}$ generally does not. This post hoc reading is proved, and illustrated outside the pair family up to $k=8$ inputs; it has no pre-registered test, only one exploratory real-data pilot. Post hoc, closed forms fall within a factor 2 of all 112 measured gaps, and negative density begins near input correlation $1/k$. In a pre-registered synthetic study (up to 32 inputs), 5 of 15 hypotheses are supported, 2 inconclusive and 8 not supported, including all three on transfer beyond equicorrelated Gaussians. 以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Efficient Online Submodular Maximization with Bandit Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We study online monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint with bandit feedback. On each round, the learner selects at most $k$ elements from a ground set of size $n$ and observes only the value of the selected set. We develop an efficient algorithm achieving $O\!\left(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)}\right)$ expected $(1-1/e)$-regret over $T$ rounds. To our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm with $\sqrt{T}$ dependence on the horizon for arbitrary monotone submodular functions in the bandit setting. Our approach uses randomized sampling and a carefully constructed potential to reduce online submodular maximization to online linear optimization over the probability simplex.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Domain-Routed Delta Optimization for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Multi-teacher on-policy distillation assigns each sample a domain teacher but typically updates shared student parameters. We introduce Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD), which specifies which parameter components each domain's samples update. The student is the sum of a frozen base and trainable components initialized from expert-minus-base weights. All components participate in every forward pass; four update modes define the correspondence between sample domains and components, each with independent optimizer states. We analyze these update rules and measure retention of the original expert geometry through angles, projection coefficients, and energy. Prior work such as Open-MOPD distills directly from the base model; 97.02% of its released final checkpoint's increment energy lies outside the span of the original expert directions. In comparison, our Own checkpoint after 20 updates retains coefficients near one along each component's original direction and pairwise angles ranging from 88.04 to 92.41 degrees; its exported BF16 student's increment has 4.90% outside energy, versus 10.52% for the sum of saved FP32 components. The same checkpoint achieves a 32.72% macro sco…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Do Time-Series Foundation Models Forecast Index-Futures Returns? A Preregistered Evaluation of Models, Metrics, and Input Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We ask whether the apparent forecasting skill of frozen time-series foundation models (TSFMs) on intraday index-futures returns is incremental skill. In a pre-registered evaluation on E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) and E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures, a common panel of five zero-shot models (Chronos-Bolt, Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Moirai 2.0 and TiRex), plus separate experiments with Kronos, is compared with a no-change forecast at 5-120 minutes, using native prices, log returns, volatility-standardised returns and a volume clock as inputs. On a blind set opened once, 0 of 160 model-representation-horizon-market cells beat no-change, and a Hansen SPA test gives p = 1.000 on both markets; a later retrospective hold-out, scored as a descriptive check, gives 0 of 120. Input representations change forecast magnitude but not accuracy, and a transformation-aware ridge regression does as well. Several standard measures nevertheless suggest skill. Price-level correlation exceeds 0.9996, but no-change scores higher. Within-day RankIC across forecast origins rewards a trivial revert-to-mean rule (+0.35 at 30 minutes); we derive the expected within-day covariance under a random walk in closed form, and a s…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. item.title: Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：高并发长上下文 LLM 服务需要随 decode 池增长的 KV 容量与注意力带宽，但现有并行策略各有权衡——数据并行复制权重限制 KV 容量，张量并行在 KV-head 数处停止扩展，DCP 分片序列却增加跨节点部分注意力聚合。如何同时扩展容量与带宽？

方法：提出 Decode Token Parallelism（TKNP）decode 池架构，解耦权重放置与注意力归属：单份模型按平衡层块分布到各节点，持有块的活动节点用节点内张量并行执行全批次投影与 MLP，每个节点对自己请求的本地 KV 计算注意力。仅当前 token 激活跨网络，稠密 all-reduce 留在 NVLink 内，注意力无需跨节点合并部分结果。

关键数字：vLLM 实现，Llama 3.1 405B 与 Nemotron-4 340B 在最多 64 张 H100 上，长上下文高并发吞吐比 DCP 最高提升 1.7×、比数据并行最高 2.06×（相同 GPU 数）。

为什么值得看：不复制权重也不跨节点聚合注意力的新并行维度，直接缓解长上下文 decode 的 KV 扩展瓶颈。

原文：Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding

item.title: DeFSM: Robust and Efficient Decentralization of Federated Submodular Maximization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Submodular maximization seeks a small subset best representing a large dataset. In its federated setting, the server is a single point of failure and some clients may be Byzantine. Removing the server raises a trilemma of decentraliza- tion, efficiency, and security. We propose DeFSM, a Byzantine-robust and communication-efficient architecture that replaces the server with a lightweight smart contract and a pool of independent, consensus-free agents. Its aggregation rule, SafeGM, builds on two notions from combinatorial geometry: Tukey depth and safe points (the points lying in the convex hull of the good points wherever the bad points are). SafeGM makes the robust decision on 2D Gaussian random projections, which the contract can compute efficiently, and lifts it back as a convex combination of actual updates. Since lifting loses information, it uses the projected geometric median only when its depth certifies it, and otherwise a Tukey median. The share of bad updates is then bounded only by a count: how many there are, not what they contain. We prove, and confirm empirically, that this bound controls the solution quality. On CIFAR10 and PathMNIST, with up to 30% Byzantine clients…

item.title: Correct First, Fast Second: What a Local 7B Code Model Can and Cannot Do for GPU Kernel Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We study how much the interaction strategy around a fixed, locally hosted 7B-parameter code model (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct) affects its ability to replace PyTorch operators with custom CUDA kernels. On 30 KernelBench tasks (levels 1-3, first 10 each, evaluated on a V100), we compare four regimes of increasing structure: zero-shot prompting, profiling-guided prompting, iterative refinement on execution feedback, and a multi-agent loop (analysis, retrieval, generation, evaluation, feedback triage) in which the same model fills four roles around a non-LLM evaluator. Three findings stand out. (1) Correctness, not speed, is the binding constraint: even correct generated kernels average 0.97-0.99x the speed of eager PyTorch, because a 7B model cannot out-write cuBLAS/cuDNN on dense GEMM and convolution; the only real wins are fused memory-bound epilogues. (2) The best strategy depends on difficulty: profiling-guided prompting is strongest overall (43% correct, 27% faster than baseline), but the agent loop is the only method that solves any level-2 fusion problem (3/10 vs. 0/10 for all others). (3) Naive agentic scaffolding is actively harmful: our first agent scored 3% correct, below z…

item.title: Controlled Binary Assignment Flows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Continuous-Time Set-Transformers for Asynchronous WiFi-IMU Indoor Localization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Indoor localization commonly combines WiFi received signal strength indicator (RSSI) fingerprints with inertial measurements. However, these sensor streams are sampled asynchronously at different rates; therefore, observations rarely align in time and may be missing or stale. Most existing methods resample the data onto a shared clock and process each modality using a separate branch. We instead present a continuous-time transformer that represents observations as an unordered set of timestamped tokens. Each token encodes its measurement, modality, and elapsed time since acquisition. A single attention block jointly fuses information across modalities and time, avoiding both resampling and modality-specific branches while remaining invariant to token order. During training, we randomly mask entire modalities and individual observations, enabling the model to operate under missing or outdated inputs. We validate the modality-specific encoders on their respective benchmarks and evaluate the fused model on both simulated and real datasets, including a crosssession dataset collected on unseen days. The proposed approach improves upon an open WiFi fingerprinting baseline under cross-ses…

item.title: Contention Resolution with a Fast-but-Fickle Channel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The contention-resolution problem studies how $n$ devices share a communication channel without centralized coordination. Classical models typically assume a single continuously available channel and focus on minimizing total completion time. However, modern wireless systems increasingly rely on shared spectrum, where access may be abruptly revoked by incumbent users. Motivated by this setting, we study contention resolution with two channels: a reliable slow channel and a faster channel that can be intermittently disabled by unpredictable eviction periods. Moving a batch of packets from the slow channel to the fast channel incurs a unit cost, while evictions from the fast channel impose a larger per-packet penalty. Our goal is to achieve asymptotically optimal latency while minimizing switching overhead relative to an optimal offline algorithm that knows the eviction schedule. We present Randomized Adaptive Channel Exploitation (RACE), a randomized algorithm that exploits the fast channel when available while maintaining progress on the slow channel during disruptions. When the fast channel has rate $ρ\in \bigl[Ω(\log n), O(\sqrt n)\bigr]$ and a sufficiently large constant-factor …

item.title: CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Stellarators are fusion devices that use externally generated, three-dimensional magnetic fields to confine hot plasma and offer a promising route to commercial fusion. Their electromagnetic coils pose a challenging design problem: they must reproduce the target magnetic field while satisfying engineering constraints and remaining practical and cost-effective to manufacture. Finding suitable geometries is a highly nonlinear inverse problem that generally has neither a closed-form nor a unique solution. This problem lies at the heart of stellarator design. We introduce CoilStellaration, a dataset and benchmark for learning the mapping between coil geometries from target plasma magnetic fields and engineering requirements. The dataset contains 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting plasma equilibria from ConStellaration, with sampled engineering requirements and achieved geometric and magnetic-field metrics. It spans multiple coil counts and field-period numbers, supporting studies of both specialized and shared models across configurations. The benchmark asks models to predict coils conditioned on a target equilibrium and requirements on coil-coil and coil-plasma spacing, …

item.title: CARE-PO: Controllable Tool-Call Efficiency for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

External tool calls are a major running cost of an LLM agent, while its training objectives align almost exclusively with task completion. In a step-level diagnosis of Qwen3.5 trajectories at two model sizes on GAIA, a long-horizon tool-use benchmark, we find that most contain removable calls, at a similar rate at both sizes. Some methods add an efficiency reward to the objective to reduce the call count, but introduce problems of their own: the anchor they price calls against is computed from the policy's own rollouts (e.g., the group's shortest correct rollout) and so moves with the policy; training can drift toward a collapsed policy that issues no tool call at all, a degeneracy seen in published reports and in our 27B baseline; and a training run delivers a single operating point, so the user cannot trade efficiency against capability. We present CARE-PO (Controllable Anchored Relative Efficiency Policy Optimization) to mitigate these problems. The efficiency reward prices calls against a reference budget anchored to the task's own difficulty and fixed before training. item.title: Byzantine-Robust Muon: Resilient Momentum Orthogonalization for Distributed Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Optimization methods, including the Muon optimizer based on the Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) and momentum orthogonalization, have shown strong empirical performance in large-scale and distributed learning, yet their robustness to adversarial behavior and data heterogeneity is not well understood. We study these methods within a unified first-order trust-region framework and analyze Muon-based updates with robust aggregation for Byzantine-robust distributed and federated learning. Our analysis does not rely on the i.i.d. assumption and introduces a non-Euclidean notion of heterogeneity consistent with the trust-region geometry. Under this framework, we establish convergence guarantees for both general non-convex and star-convex objectives. Our results provide a theoretical characterization of Byzantine-robust Muon-based optimization, with an additive heterogeneity error floor consistent with known impossibility results, under explicit aggregation assumptions. Under an explicit additive oracle-error condition, the guarantees also cover inexact orthogonalization, with the non-convex Byzantine terms in the bound's numerator unchanged but a smaller progress denominator. item.title: Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Unlike the brain, artificial neural networks (ANNs) suffer from "catastrophic forgetting": complete overwriting of solutions when re-training on new functions ("concept shift") or on a disjoint domain of the current function ("domain shift"). ANNs require each batch of data to be roughly representative of the complete distribution, a typically expensive and impractical requirement. In this paper, we introduce Functional Task Networks (FTNs), a method of continual learning and knowledge transfer modeled after several properties of the mammalian neocortex. FTN is formulated as a distributed, stochastic mixture of experts in which a sparse, binary routing mask is computed at inference time using a small support sample of input-output pairs. Per-batch reconfiguration of the router during training, together with mask-overlap-filtered replay, shapes a basis of overlapping, partially trained subnetworks. Unrelated tasks route through mostly separate assemblies, related tasks overlap on shared components. On block-sequentially trained continual learning and knowledge transfer tasks FTN retains solutions nearly as well as disjoint-mask isolation and attains the lowest pre-update head-start …

item.title: Audited Gradients, Anchored Policies: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Flow Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Feedback controllers for flows are expensive to design, since each candidate must be evaluated with a high-fidelity solver. Differentiable surrogates reduce that cost, but they also introduce a failure mode that prediction error cannot detect. Policy optimization uses the derivative of the objective with respect to the action, which we call the action gradient and which can be computed either through the surrogate or through the high-fidelity solver. Optimization through the surrogate uses only its action gradient, and a surrogate can follow the flow trajectory closely while misestimating this derivative. The surrogate action gradient is compared against a central finite-difference estimate from the high-fidelity solver on held-out states, under acceptance criteria fixed before the comparison, and we call that comparison an audit. item.title: Attention Is Only as Good as Its Witnesses: When Higher-Order Layers Help, and When They Do Not
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Transformers stop learning graph search as graphs grow, and learn the card game SET only after many distinct questions, although attention can represent both. We read these failures, and the uneven record of higher-order attention, from what a layer sums over: each layer we study computes the partition function of a family of witnesses and reads it at a temperature. Two laws follow. The depth law is a known result of logic, which we state for these layers: L layers over two-step walks reach exactly 2^L - 1 steps, just as a logical statement with L nested clauses of the form "there is a vertex such that" sees exactly that far. We build a construction that reaches this far, checked in Lean, and, when vertices carry no names, no such network reaches further. The size law is the cost of reading at a temperature, which logic does not have: existence is read correctly at every size, in the worst case, if and only if inverse temperature times margin is at least the logarithm of the number of candidates. Layers built on these laws, and on two principles that we test, learn where Transformers fail. One propagator layer trained on 49-vertex graphs answers every question at every search depth…

item.title: AscSpMM: Efficient SpMM on Ascend NPUs via Pipelined Vector-Cube Collaboration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 NPU 矩阵引擎与软件管理片上内存偏好稠密计算，而 SpMM（图分析、稀疏神经网络、科学计算关键内核）需要索引驱动操作数选择、间接寻址、分散访存与负载均衡，与 NPU 固定形状/连续布局冲突；GPU Tensor Core 方法无法直接迁移到向量/矩阵引擎解耦的 NPU。

方法 提出 AscSpMM：用参数化 Vector-CSR 表示把不规则操作数准备与规则矩阵计算分离——向量引擎解码索引、收集重排稠密操作数，Cube 引擎做矩阵乘累加；双槽环形缓冲实现依赖感知异步流水，操作数复用与运行时自适应分块减少跨引擎停顿。

关键数字 Ascend 910B3 上相对 GEMM 几何平均加速 2.36x、相对既有 SpMM 实现 19.92x、相对 A100 上 cuSPARSE 5.82x；矩阵输入存储与峰值 HBM 占用平均降 48.24% 与 22.98%，与专用 GPU Tensor Core SpMM 内核竞争力相当。

为什么值得看 NPU 上 SpMM 的向量-矩阵引擎协同设计范式，含异步流水与访存优化细节，代码已开源。

item.title: An Open Implementation Flow for the Xilinx Spartan-3E and Spartan-6 that Runs in the Browser, Checked Byte for Byte Against ISE
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The author describes an open implementation flow, from HDL to a programmable bitstream, for the Xilinx Spartan-3E (XC3S100E to XC3S1200E) and Spartan-6 (XC6SLX16, XC6SLX45), devices that only the discontinued ISE 14.7 supports. The flow runs unchanged in a web browser or in Node.js: Yosys and nextpnr compiled to WebAssembly, with nextpnr's Himbaechel framework given Spartan-3E and Spartan-6 architectures generated from Silinx's own device descriptions, bit database and timing model, and Silinx's own bitstream writer. The bit database was built by black-box observation of ISE's documented XDL and bitgen tools, using codeword-batched experiments; the router is given only switches whose bits were measured, and the writer refuses a feature it has not measured. ISE is the oracle: for the same placed and routed design, the bitstream is byte-identical to the one bitgen writes and ISE's DRC is clean. Placement and routing were first done by an in-house annealer and PathFinder router, which nextpnr replaced once it matched them. item.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Stability in Network Intrusion Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Quantum kernel methods have been proposed for network intrusion detection, yet their performance limitations are often attributed to noise in current quantum hardware. This study evaluates that assumption through a controlled analysis of Pegasos-QSVC on the NSL-KDD and ToN-IoT datasets. We perform 56 quantum experiments using one exact noiseless statevector backend and three noise-simulated superconducting backends while keeping preprocessing, PCA features, data splits, and classical baselines identical. XGBoost achieves accuracies of 98.94% on NSL-KDD and 99.41% on ToN-IoT, compared with 91.80% and 82.98% for Pegasos-QSVC. The quantum model also exhibits substantially greater seed-dependent variability. Eight runs collapse into degenerate classifiers, including four recall-collapse cases and four trivial-positive classifiers. Notably, two failures occur on the noiseless backend, demonstrating that hardware noise is not a necessary condition for classi-fier collapse. Kernel Gram matrix analysis further reveals low effective rank and severe ill-conditioning even in the absence of noise, indicating intrinsic fragility in the learned quantum representation. item.title: An Analytical Model of Compute-limited Multistage Training Pipelines
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Modern foundation models are trained through multiple stages, yet how these stages interact and how compute should be allocated across them remain poorly understood. We introduce an analytically tractable high-dimensional model combining unsupervised pretraining with a linear autoencoder, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with noisy stepwise labels, and reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse episodic rewards. Using random matrix theory and an operator-projection closure, we derive approximate low-dimensional learning dynamics that closely match simulations. We show that finite pretraining data imposes a representation-dependent performance limit, with Bayes classification error scaling as the inverse square root of the pretraining sample ratio, and observe the same exponent in asymptotic SFT and RL errors. Better pretraining also reduces sensitivity to noisy supervision. SFT initialization shortens the initial RL plateau induced by sparse rewards, an effect we also observe in OLMo-2 1B on GSM8K. Longer SFT warm starts additionally improve asymptotic RL performance. Optimizing compute across all three stages reveals that the optimal allocation depends on supervision quality and total bu…

item.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered.
