item.title: Where Should Models Run? A Collaborative Inference Framework for Embodied Intelligence in 6G
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Embodied intelligence systems rely on fast and reliable inference to enable real-time perception, reasoning, and control. Recent advances in large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have significantly enhanced the capabilities of embodied agents in complex environments. However, deploying these models remains challenging due to the limited computational resources and energy budgets of robotic platforms. A fundamental question is where inference should be executed. Collaborative inference, which partitions models across end devices, edge servers, and the cloud, has emerged as a promising solution. Yet determining the optimal partitioning point remains an open problem, as it depends on wireless network conditions, model structure, and privacy requirements. This article reviews the state of the art in collaborative inference for embodied intelligence and proposes an edge-centric framework in which the edge coordinates model partitioning and execution. item.title: Universal Approximation by Equivariant Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks with a Bilinear Readout
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

We prove universal approximation for the bilinear-readout equivariant message-passing network (BREMP), a reference architecture for equivariant graph neural network interatomic potentials. Its layers combine equivariant convolutions with affine maps, and its readout forms invariants from products of the equivariant features. We construct a one-layer feature that determines the local environment up to permutations of atoms of the same type. The construction uses spherical harmonic filters of degree no larger than the largest number of neighbors at a common distance from the center. Iterating the construction recovers the environment reachable in as many hops as there are layers, using the same bound on filter degrees at the layer cutoff. The readout approximates every continuous invariant function of the features uniformly on compact sets. Together these give universal approximation of atomic energies at a prescribed physical range using a shorter layer cutoff. We assume that, throughout the admissible class, message passing reaches all neighbors in each physical environment within a common number of layers. item.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Our method, Deletion Tuning, learns a binary mask over the gate projection of transformer blocks. Two practical advantages follow: the trained mask is hundreds to thousands of times smaller than the corresponding FFT checkpoint, and Deletion Tuning forgets far less, which addresses a central challenge in continual learning. Under reinforcement learning, its prior-task accuracy stays near the base level while FFT, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points. To understand why masking alone suffices, we analyze the geometry of the learned weight changes under reinforcement learning using stable rank, spectrum drift, and principal-weight overlap. Compared with LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning, Deletion Tuning is closest to FFT across the three measures.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SWXAI: A Unified Multimodal Explainability Library for Space Weather Forecasting and Heliophysics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Space weather forecasting and heliophysics increasingly rely on machine learning models that process heterogeneous inputs such as multi-viewpoint multi-wavelength solar images and rasters, multivariate time series, spatial annotations, and tabular event-level data. However, explainability workflows remain fragmented across libraries, model interfaces, and output formats, limiting reuse and reproducibility. We present SWXAI, an open-source library that unifies explainable AI (XAI) workflows for image, time-series, and tabular data in space weather forecasting and heliophysics. SWXAI provides a common, extensible interface across commonly used vision, time-series, and tabular learning models, with validation, adaptation, and persistent explanation objects. It also includes domain-grounded examples, reproducible notebooks, tests, and documentation, enabling users to inspect outputs, swap models or explainers, and extend workflows to new heliophysics datasets. SWXAI reduces modality-specific engineering overhead and supports comparable, reusable explanations across heterogeneous scientific machine learning pipelines. item.title: Robust and Efficient Continual Model Merging via Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Continual model merging incrementally integrates task-specific models without revisiting past models or data. However, repeated merging entangles past task components and distorts their singular geometry, making balanced task-wise allocation increasingly difficult. We propose Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration (GS3R), which augments the merged update with a compact restoration state. At each merge, GS3R restores the retained singular geometry, separates task-wise subspaces, and globally reallocates the available rank across tasks fairly. To reduce merging-time memory overhead, we further introduce Pre-merge Restoration and Flushing (PRF). Experiments on vision, NLP, and multimodal benchmarks show that GS3R provides a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Reproducible LoRA Inference Through Deterministic Split-K Reduction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LoRA 适配模型用于重复评测、审计与决策时，Split-K 内核用浮点原子加法合并部分结果会引入数值不确定性。

方法 在 vLLM 中调查 GSM8K 数学推理、MBPP 代码生成与 Civil Comments 结构化毒性决策上的不确定性问题，提出确定性的 Triton Split-K 实现（确定性归约替代浮点原子加法）。

关键数字 相同输入重放下 Atomic Split-K=8 在 97.61% 比较中产生不同 FP32 shrink 输出，确定性 Split-K=8 零变化；原子推理在 17.30% GSM8K、14.96% MBPP 比较中改变生成输出，81.47% 结构化决策概率变化出现决策翻转；确定性 Split-K=8 相对非拆分归约获 16.8–21.1% 延迟加速，相对原子版仅增 1.02–2.62% 延迟。

为什么值得看 量化了 Split-K 非确定性如何经 KV cache 传播改变最终答案，并给出保留并行性的确定性修复。

item.title: Representing Tensors as Compositions for Efficient Computation on Sparse and Structured Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

We propose a new mathematical formalism in which all kinds of tensors and of operations on those tensors are represented as simple function compositions. Tensors are functions from indices to values. An element-wise operation (e.g. an activation function) is a composition with a function applied to values; re-indexing (e.g. reshape, transposition) is a composition with a function applied to indices; and a reduction is a composition with both an index function, mapping each index to several indices, and a reduction operation (e.g. product, sum, max). Combined with tensor stacking, these compositions can represent most interesting kinds of tensors (e.g. dense, jagged, all kinds of sparsity patterns, matrix factorizations), as well as lazy versions of almost every operation available in modern tensor computation frameworks, including einsums between tensors of any kind. Identities between compositions can then be used to rewrite such expressions into equivalent ones, without evaluating them. item.title: RTLREX: LLM-Guided Framework for Exact High-Level RTL Recovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Hardware designs may be available only as gate-level netlists or input-output descriptions when the original register-transfer-level (RTL) design and documentation are not accessible. Low-level representations obscure word-level computation and its finite-width behavior. Recovering high-level RTL from such representations therefore helps engineers understand a circuit's functionality and enables RTL rewriting and resynthesis. A plausible function model is also insufficient unless the generated RTL is equivalent to the original circuit for all input combinations. In this paper, we present RTLREX, a large language model (LLM)-guided framework that coordinates domain-specific tools for function recovery, RTL generation, independent verification, and cost-guided rewriting. Independent verification establishes equivalence between the recovered RTL and the original circuit. The LLM uses tool feedback to select further analyses, revise candidate RTL, and propose syntax-cost reductions. Experiments on 30 benchmarks from Problem A of the ICCAD 2022 CAD Contest show that RTLREX recovers equivalent high-level RTL for all benchmarks, surpassing the state-of-the-art method WolFEx in recovery co…

item.title: Pruning DNA Sequence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Data pruning can substantially reduce training cost by removing examples that contribute little additional learning signal, but it has not been studied for DNA language-model pretraining. We introduce Sequence Pruning (SP), a dynamic pruning framework that removes genomic sequences as they become easy for the model to predict. SP uses per-sequence pretraining accuracy computed directly from the model's forward pass, requiring no separate scoring model or additional pass over the corpus. We evaluate SP across five pretraining settings spanning two corpora, three model families, and both MLM and CLM objectives, with downstream evaluation on five genomic benchmarks. SP reduces pretraining data processing by up to 96% while largely preserving downstream performance. At moderate savings, pruning improves performance by up to 1.2 MCC points over full-data pretraining; at the highest savings, pretraining uses only 4% of the baseline GPU hours with little performance loss. SP also outperforms the dynamic pruning methods InfoBatch and BPAS across most comparisons. Beyond accuracy, our framework supports alternative criteria such as perplexity and EL2N, although accuracy yields the strongest…

item.title: Prescriptive Learning of Linear Policies with Feasibility Guarantees for Binary Decision-Making
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Binary decision-making under uncertainty arises across a wide range of applications, including energy systems scheduling, transportation, and workforce planning. While machine learning has been increasingly applied to accelerate or replace mixed-integer solvers in such settings, existing approaches rely on predictive learning, training models to reproduce optimal decisions from labeled data, which lacks knowledge of counterfactual outcomes and provides no guarantees that the resulting decisions will be feasible. This limitation is further compounded under distributional shift, where policies trained on historical data may produce systematically infeasible decisions. We propose a prescriptive learning framework for binary decision-making that addresses both limitations. Rather than predicting optimal labels, the framework jointly optimizes over linear decision policies and feasible assignments across all training scenarios, allowing feasible alternatives and their operational performance to be considered directly during training. item.title: Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping for Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Extended reasoning can help language models solve complex problems, but long responses often contain both useful computations and redundant checks. Conventional length penalties encourage shorter responses without distinguishing the functions of intermediate steps. We propose Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping (PCRS), a framework that combines phase identification with training-time reward allocation. We investigate two classification routes: PCRS-H with a hidden-state classifier and PCRS-T with a frozen text classifier. Our main text classifier implementation assigns overlapping reasoning, execution, and revision labels to native chunks, then uses these labels and exact repetition to adjust existing token penalties. We compare the completed configurations on six mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks and examine four reward-weight settings with the text classifier. Compared with a baseline using token-level length penalties, the default text classifier configuration reduces mean response length by 3.13%; sampled Pass@1 is approximately 62.07% for both methods, while oracle Pass@16 rises from 86.08% to 87.67%. item.title: Performance Benchmarking of Federated Learning Frameworks for Medical Image Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Selecting a Federated Learning (FL) framework requires understanding the resource demands of its training and evaluation workflow. This work compares Flower, NVIDIA FLARE, and FedBioMed using two-dimensional MedNIST classification with ResNet-10 in a containerized, single-host environment. Following a dated review of repository activity and documented medical applications, we evaluated nine configurations per framework, with three random seeds, for a total of 81 executions. The configurations varied federation size, communication rounds, and batch size. We monitored execution time, CPU and RAM consumption, host-level GPU utilization, server network traffic rates, and model accuracy at the end of each execution. The implementations shared nominal learning settings while retaining differences in data splitting and federated evaluation. Configuration-blocked non-parametric analysis identified differences in execution time, client and server memory, GPU utilization, and network traffic rates. NVIDIA FLARE exhibited the lowest server-memory consumption and the highest host-level GPU utilization, Flower exhibited the highest average server network traffic rate, and FedBioMed required mor…

item.title: PENSA: A Spatial Accelerator for BitNet b1.58 Inference on an HBM-equipped AMD Alveo FPGA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 三元大模型（tLLM）把线性层中的通用乘法换成符号控制累加，硬件瓶颈转向打包权重输送、归约与算子占用；端到端 FPGA 推理方案缺乏。

方法 PENSA：面向 BitNet b1.58 2B4T 模型的 FPGA 加速器，搭载 AMD Alveo U50；两个行分区三元矩阵引擎从 8 个 HBM 伪通道消费打包 TQ1_0 权重，每周期经符号选择与整数归约处理 1,280 个三元权重；序列器、注意力与词汇投影单元常驻 FPGA，双流交错调度组成 Penta-Unit 流水线。

关键数字 104.1MHz 下 context 128 达 58.09 tok/s、context 2048 达 24.60 tok/s，为同模型 Xeon E-2356G 基线的 2.14–3.14x 吞吐；不改模型结构完成 2B 级 BitNet 拓扑端到端 FPGA 执行。

为什么值得看 完整跑通三元 LLM 的 FPGA 端到端推理，含 HBM 多通道权重供给与常驻单元设计。

item.title: Optimal Byzantine-resilient Federated Learning with User-level Differential Privacy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Real-world deployment of federated learning (FL) requires resilience against adversarial clients and data privacy. Byzantine fault captures the worst-case behavior of adversarial clients, while differential privacy (DP) provides statistical guarantees against privacy loss. In particular, user-level DP guards a client's entire contribution and provides more realistic protection against information leakage. Despite intensive efforts, the minimax-optimal convergence bound of Byzantine-resilient FL with user-level DP remains open. We establish an information-theoretic lower bound for any Byzantine-resilient empirical risk minimization problem under user-level DP and heterogeneous clients. We propose ByzULDP, a central DP algorithm featuring a two-level momentum across the client and server. Client-side momentum mitigates stochastic gradient variance during robust aggregation. Unlike the fault-free case, naively combining non-linear Byzantine-resilient aggregation with central DP noise can be insufficient to guarantee convergence to a bounded neighborhood of a stationary point. item.title: OneReel: Efficient Multi-Scene Video Generation with Scene-Structured Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Multi-scene video generation must follow scene-specific prompts while preserving consistency across scenes. Dense joint generation enables cross-scene information exchange but incurs quadratic attention cost, whereas separate generation avoids this cost at the expense of cross-scene consistency. We present OneReel, a training-free system that exploits scene structure to enable efficient multi-scene generation. Our key insight is that multi-scene generation can preserve complete intra-scene attention while restricting cross-scene information exchange to a bounded shared memory. OneReel uses scene prompts and durations to establish scene-specific attention scopes and dynamically selects a bounded set of representative latent frames for cross-scene sharing. This reduces video attention complexity from quadratic to linear in the number of scenes. To translate these savings into execution speedups, OneReel packs scene-local and shared K/V into dense variable-length attention and employs work-balanced multi-GPU partitioning with communication-aware selection between K/V gathering and Ulysses-style parallelism. Our evaluations across four video generation models show that OneReel achieves…

item.title: On the universal structure in deterministic generative diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion-based generative modeling has emerged as a general computational framework for simulating high-dimensional, structured data across various domains. Understanding its generative mechanisms is paramount for advancing model training and inference in a principled way. Here, we demonstrate that deterministic sampling trajectories share a universal geometric structure invariant to data modalities and diffusion model implementations. This structure can be largely explained by an exactly solvable model based on the optimal linear denoiser.

item.title: Network Contention State Aware Dynamic Optimizer for Accelerator Collective Communication Libraries
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Collective Communication Libraries (CCL) are critical for large-scale distributed AI/ML training, yet their configurations are determined by static heuristics that do not account for real-time network conditions. Our empirical study shows that these heuristics perform near-optimally in contention-free environments, but degrade substantially under background traffic. To address this, we present a cooperative multi-agent run-time optimizer for accelerator collective communication. Our approach employs a two-agent architecture: (i) detector- a Long Short Term Memory(LSTM) recurring neural network fed classifier head with a sequential probability ratio test that distinguishes sustained contention from transient spikes; and (ii) selector- a configuration selector built on a Dueling Double DQN (D3QN) with Conservative Q-Learning that adapts configuration parameters in response. We implemented this dynamic tuner over NCCL, a widely used CCL developed by NVIDIA. When evaluated on Chameleon Cloud's isolated bare-metal cluster, this dynamic tuning approach reduces AllReduce latency by 36% over NCCL and 32% over a fully converged AutoCCL. We further evaluated it across six real AI workloads s…

item.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 权重-激活量化能降低推理内存与计算成本，但近期方法常需昂贵优化与跨层基础变换传播，架构相关性强。

方法 提出 MACaQ，MXFP4 W4A4 训练后量化方法，逐线性层独立处理：在线对每层激活做逐通道 scale 与块 Hadamard 变换，相应逆变换吸收进权重；另引入 Flip-Refinement，基于 Hessian 的坐标下降贪心把单个 FP4 码移到相邻可表示值。

关键数字 Qwen3-32B 在 vLLM 上相比纯 MXFP4 仅增 2.3% 端到端开销；比 DuQuant++ 与 MR-GPTQ 更低困惑度，Llama-3-8B 上以 11 倍更短的量化时间达到其最佳困惑度；122B 模型量化仅 64 分钟、32.5GB GPU 显存；无需架构改造即可用于图像扩散模型。

为什么值得看 逐层独立 + 流式实现的 W4A4 量化，速度快、内存省、模型无关。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Foundation models pretrained on similar data distributions tend to learn overlapping semantic structure, but their representations are distinct due to different model architecture, pretraining objectives and protocols. This prevents unified interpretability and cross-model feature reuse. Existing approaches extract interpretable concepts from individual models and align these concepts in a shared coordinate system using cross-reconstruction objectives, but the alignment only applies to latent coordinates while the concepts themselves remain model-specific and cannot be shared or reused. This paper introduces the Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoder (GB-SAE), which casts unified cross-model interpretability as a representation factorization problem and solves it by simultaneously learning a unified shared dictionary and multiple private model-specific dictionaries via a gated bottleneck sparse autoencoder framework. The shared dictionary encodes the cross-model common semantic structure in unified concepts that are reusable across all participating models (and beyond), while each private dictionary comprises residual concepts that capture model-specific biases. item.title: Learning Actionable Information Landscapes for Multimodal Active Sensing in Hawkmoths
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Animals integrate information across sensory modalities to guide exploration, suggesting that they maintain internal estimates of where actions are expected to reduce uncertainty. However, how such action-conditioned information maps are learned from multimodal sensory experience remains unclear, as previous studies have been largely confined to unimodal sensing frameworks. We introduce a multimodal predictive-coding framework for learning uncertainty-reduction maps from visual and mechanosensory observations in hawkmoth flower interaction tasks. A variational generative model trained on simulated environments recovers modality-specific information landscapes over the action space, capturing how visual patterns, surface geometry, and mechanosensory cues shape the value of exploratory actions. These learned maps are consistent with several features of hawkmoth behavior, including nonzero tracking offsets, probing along visual patterns, and geometry-dependent exploration. Applying the model to behavioral data from flower tracking and nectary search, we find that natural trajectories tend to occupy regions of high uncertainty reduction in these learned maps. item.title: JUBILEE: A Benchmark Environment for Off-Policy Evaluation in Debt Collections
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value a candidate decision policy would achieve, using only data logged by the policy already in production. In debt collections, unrecorded factors can influence both actions and outcomes. This paper presents JUBILEE, a benchmark environment built around a debt-collections simulator that generates million-loan panels with competing risks, rare recovery events, and hidden factors driving both outcomes and assignment. The evaluation includes an 80-run comparison of tabular and gradient-boosted estimators under two synthetic outcome mechanisms and a 190-run parameter grid. Independent policy simulations provide reference values with estimated Monte Carlo uncertainty for a synthetic reward score and for simulated cash. With hidden factors influencing action assignment, several tabular methods agree closely while underestimating the field-visit policy's score, an error that also appears with boosted models. item.title: Hydro-Dataset: A Multi-Modal Open-Source Pipeline for Nordic Hydrological Research and Foundation Model Benchmarking
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Despite world-class snow monitoring by the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI) and Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI), no station-anchored, multi-parameter snow benchmark dataset exists for the Nordic boreal domain. We present Hydro-Dataset v1.1, a reproducible open-source pipeline that harmonizes 582 SMHI meteorological observation stations across nine hydrological winters (2015/16-2023/24) into a CF-1.9 NetCDF product with 1.8~million annotated station-days. Six derived snow parameters, such as Snow Water Equivalent (SWE), snow phenology, melt rates, degree-day melt factor, rain-on-snow flags, and freeze-thaw cycles, supply benchmark-ready labels for hydrological foundation model training. ERA5-Land cross-validation (Pearson R=0.78, bias=-262mm) confirms observation-anchored SWE provides a more reliable benchmark than reanalysis for machine learning training.

item.title: HexIt: Learning Hexahedral Block Decomposition with Expert Iteration on Combinatorial Maps
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Decomposing a polyhedral solid into a few well-shaped hexahedral blocks is a long-standing open problem in mesh generation. We cast it as a sequential decision problem on a 3-dimensional generalised map: an agent splits edges, faces and volumes with three insert operations until every cell is a hexahedron and the mesh passes a quality threshold, and a policy that convolves over the map's involutions chooses each insert. A successful decomposition takes over a hundred decisions, and a uniformly random policy never finds one. We clone a policy from constructed decompositions and improve it by expert iteration. On held-out chamfered solids that share no boundary topology with the cloning data, the final policy solves an expected $94.4\%$ in $20$ samples, and expert iteration raises the best-of-20 solve rate on large chamfered solids from $0.203$ to $0.355$. At matched compute, PPO, GRPO and VinePPO updates all make the cloned policy worse.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: GradReason: LLMs as Meta-Learners that Replace Training Epochs with Training-Data-Free Weight Updates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Standard training recipes make a fixed number of passes over the training data, even when an epoch mostly adds mini-batch noise. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that reads the weight and gradient history of a run can replace some of these epochs with updates that compute no gradient and read no training image. In GradReason, an LLM agent is called every ten epochs. In a restricted sandbox, it analyses recent weight snapshots, epoch-mean gradients, and validation metrics, then submits a Python program that computes new weights and a plan marking each of the next ten epochs as data or virtual. A virtual epoch is kept only if it passes a forward-only check on 5,000 held-out validation images. In 120 runs on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with three architectures, Claude Opus 5.5 used 32.8% fewer data epochs than the 80-epoch recipe at 0.31 percentage points lower test accuracy (95% CI -0.72 to +0.09; 0.94 points on ResNet-18), on the recipe's own frontier of data against accuracy. Unprompted, Opus averaged recent weight snapshots in every run. item.title: Firepool: Brokering Warm GPU Capacity for Agentic and RL Workloads at LinkedIn
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 AI agent 与 RL 训练器运行成千上万个短小的隔离 GPU 任务（工具调用、验证器、rollout），任务秒级完成但启动 GPU pod 需 20–35 秒甚至数分钟；热 pod 既要消除等待又不能浪费 GPU 或泄漏状态。

方法 Firepool（LinkedIn 的沙箱与执行经纪）：按硬件画像用共享基础镜像构建可互换 pod，任务开始时才绑定代码与依赖；仅把 pod 复用于上一个调用者、以分片 GPU 共享部署零 VRAM 待机 pod、用队列驱动预算限制热池 GPU 容量。

关键数字 峰值期 94.7% 的 3,206 个 pod 请求由热/待机容量服务；固定时长任务对比新 pod 每任务，agent 与 RL 循环分别快 13x 与 10.8x；热复用把 p90 启动延迟从 59.1s 降至 3.5s；待机晋升把切换等待从 51s 缩至 0.94s。

为什么值得看 生产级 warm-pool 经纪系统设计：可互换性、安全复用与容量成本三者如何同时满足。

item.title: Finite Time Analysis of Risk-Sensitive RL via Noisy Power Iteration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Estimating the principal eigenpair of a positive operator from stochastic evaluations gives rise to a noisy form of normalized power iteration: each step applies a sampled operator estimate and then renormalizes. We establish finite-time stochastic-approximation guarantees for this procedure, working in Hilbert's projective metric, which is well-suited to the multiplicative geometry of Perron--Frobenius eigenproblems. Our main application is risk-sensitive average-cost reinforcement learning (RL) with exponential utility. In this setting the Bellman equations are multiplicative, and value functions are characterized by nonlinear eigenvalue problems rather than additive fixed points. We cast both policy evaluation and control in this framework, obtaining risk-sensitive TD- and Q-learning algorithms that learn from a single Markovian trajectory. Under explicit positivity, mixing, and linear function approximation assumptions, we prove finite-time bounds on the recovered eigenvector and eigenvalue with $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ sample complexity up to problem-dependent constants. The results cover both tabular and linear function approximation regimes, and through the duality between…

item.title: FedSGN: Federated Sparse Grassmann Newton Learning for IoT Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Anomaly detection plays a critical role in securing the Internet of things (IoT). Although existing federated principal component analysis (PCA) methods can learn the subspace of normal samples without sharing raw data, they often suffer from feature redundancy that may degrade detection performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel and effective federated sparse Grassmann Newton (FedSGN) learning method for IoT anomaly detection. Technically, our FedSGN leverages the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm constraint on the global projection matrix to eliminate redundancy and introduces an orthogonality penalty to preserve the intrinsic structure. Moreover, we develop an augmented Lagrangian solver integrated with a semismooth Newton scheme to enable parallel client updates and Grassmann projection for robustness. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable overall detection performance while reducing communication overhead. The source code is publicly available at this https URL

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FADE: Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation for Training-Free Diffusion Transformers Acceleration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as the preeminent paradigm for high-fidelity generative modeling across various modalities, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the severe computational overhead of iterative sampling. While recent feature-caching methods mitigate this latency through feature reuse or forecasting based on integer-order operators, they remain limited in adapting to the non-stationary and highly curved dynamics of DiT latent trajectories. In this work, we reveal that DiT feature evolution exhibits anomalous diffusion characteristics and a certain degree of spatiotemporal heterogeneity, rendering static, integer-order forecasting operators inadequate and prone to error accumulation. To address this, we propose Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation (FADE), a unified framework for training-free diffusion transformers acceleration. FADE models DiT feature evolution via anomalous diffusion and employs a Mittag--Leffler fractional operator to better adapt to high-curvature and non-linear latent trajectories of DiTs. item.title: Exploration via Exploitation: The Blessing of Reward Diversity in Personalized Federated RL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

While federated reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally guaranteed high efficiency in homogeneous environments, collaboration is often hindered when agents possess distinct goals. In this paper, we flip this paradigm, framing reward heterogeneity not as a hurdle to consensus, but as a structural asset that catalyzes exploration. We first propose Personalized Federated Upper Confidence Bound Value Iteration (PF-UCBVI), which achieves optimal linear speedup by decoupling shared dynamics from personalized objectives. To eliminate the risks of explicit exploration, we then introduce Personalized Federated Exploration-Free Value Iteration (PF-EFVI), a purely greedy algorithm that leverages reward diversity to ensure state-action coverage. We prove that PF-EFVI attains logarithmic regret without explicit exploration bonuses under sufficient reward diversity. Our results reveal that agent disagreement shifts the exploration burden from temporal complexity to spatial diversity, enabling efficient collective learning without explicit exploration.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used to measure brain activity for brain-computer interface applications for its non-invasive nature and high temporal resolution. However, progress in modeling the neural responses to visual semantics has been limited by a reliance on fixed image collections that lack the fine-grained control needed to isolate fine-grained changes in visual features and their relation to perception. In this work, we present EEGFaceSem, a large-scale dataset pairing high-quality EEG with photorealistic face images synthesized from a generative model. We provide the generative latent vector for each stimulus, enabling research into the continuous mapping between a visual latent space and neural representations. Each participant's brain responses were recorded while they attended to specific semantic features (e.g., smiling, hair color) in a rapid serial visual presentation paradigm. The dataset contains EEG signals from 30 participants, totaling 67,200 time-locked EEG recordings. item.title: Dynamic State Estimation from Sparse PMUs via Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

This paper proposes a physics-informed graph neural operator for power system dynamic state estimation. From a sparse, intermittent measurement window at a few generator buses, the operator estimates the rotor-angle and speed trajectories of all machines, unmeasured ones included, in one forward pass. A graph-attention encoder processes the measurements, and the swing equations are imposed as a hard constraint or as a soft one with a learned correction that absorbs model errors. It is trained on simulated measurements, without state labels. With several phasor measurement units, masked training hides one from the input but keeps it in the loss. On four transmission systems, simulations show that the operator is the most accurate estimator that neither optimizes per scenario nor uses state labels, except on the smallest system at large model errors, where tuned Kalman smoothers are better. Networks trained on simulated states are more accurate on the two smallest systems but not on the 118-bus system, where the operator is faster and more accurate than hard-constrained moving-horizon estimation. Under model errors, it matches or outperforms an optimization-based benchmark at a fract…

item.title: Detent: Batch-Invariant LLM Serving and RL Rollouts at Near-Stock Speed
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 可复现评测、可验证推理与 on-policy RL 要求 LLM 引擎对同一请求无论与谁同批都给出相同输出比特；引擎的确定性模式靠每算子保留一个保守内核来消除选择，但付出延迟代价。

方法 Detent 把内核选择表达为引擎可执行的程序，找出该程序中必须固定的最少批相关值，并在部署前按负载调优——多数快速内核本身即批无关，只需修少数几个选择读取的值。

关键数字 Llama-3.1-70B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 vLLM/SGLang 多 GPU 部署下完全批无关；按负载调优后每输出 token 延迟为 Stock 的 1.04–1.17x（确定性模式为 1.67–10.3x）；训练器在 Detent 内核上逐 bit 复现 rollout logprob，为 Stock 的 1.03x 耗时；BF16 GRPO 在 Stock 崩溃时保持稳定。

为什么值得看 用最小固定集换取批不变性，摆脱确定性模式的高延迟惩罚，直接服务于可复现 RL 训练。

为什么值得看 用最小固定集换取批不变性，摆脱确定性模式的高延迟惩罚，直接服务于可复现 RL 训练。

item.title: DICOMPUTE: An Economic and Privacy-Aware Framework for Distributed Artificial Intelligence Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

The prevailing design of large-scale artificial intelligence inference concentrates accelerators, model weights, and request processing in centralized computing facilities. Centralization offers important benefits in accelerator utilization, high-bandwidth interconnects, operational control, and serving efficiency. Yet centralized infrastructure is not always the least-cost or most governance-compatible choice for every inference workload. This paper develops a research framework for DICOMPUTE, a heterogeneous distributed inference architecture in which policy-constrained scheduling can allocate suitable requests across privately controlled, regional, and independently operated computing resources. We derive a full-cost comparison that accounts for capital amortization, energy, network transfer, orchestration, utilization, failures, and trust-related expenses; characterize conditions under which distributed inference can outperform centralized alternatives; and specify a privacy model separating data residency, transport confidentiality, execution confidentiality, and verifiable accounting. item.title: Crustify: Repository-Level Generation of Safe Rust Bindings with LLM Agents and Coverage-Guided Testing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Wrapping C code in a safe Rust interface lets Rust applications use it without writing unsafe code, until the code itself is migrated to Rust. Such bindings are tedious and error-prone to write, however: their internals use unsafe code that the Rust compiler does not check, so a single mistake can introduce undefined behavior (UB), and they have so far been written mostly by hand. We present Crustify, an agentic co-translator that generates safe Rust bindings for repository-level C libraries. Crustify schedules a target's types and symbols into dependency-ordered waves of independent batches that agents bind concurrently. Its agents derive the ownership and lifecycle contract of every pointer and type they wrap, check each binding with coverage-guided equivalence and UB tests under sanitizers and Miri, and review every wave. They build on three tools that we contribute: (a) ffibox, Rust primitives for C/Rust interop that mirror Box, Arc, and Vec for C objects without ever forming a reference to memory that C may alias; (b) Wavefront, a neuro-symbolic static analyzer that orders a target's items by their dependencies, including those that casts and type-erased pointers hide; and (c)…

item.title: Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏注意力加速长上下文解码，但现有方法是开环的：内核选定子集后没有任何信号表明注意力质量是否保留，也没有失败恢复路径。

方法 提出 CVSA（Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention）：利用被选 token 上的 softmax 质量占比（coverage）与每步输出误差的精确代数等式，把 coverage 同时用作接受判据与恢复插值权重，形成免训练、闭环的「验证-修正」解码循环，无需采样、草稿模型或投机解码设施。

关键数字 质量随阈值扫描仅波动 0.14 分；LongBench 7B/70B 上距密集注意力仅 1.13 分（70B 统计上持平），RULER 仅损 0.8 分；128K 上下文下中位解码步加速 6.21x。

为什么值得看 用内核内已存在的 coverage 信号把稀疏注意力从开环变成闭环，方法简洁且训练无关。

item.title: CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 1-bit KV cache 压缩误差大，如何把量化器校准与选择性高精度存储结合以降低重建误差。

方法 提出 CALFA-KV：离线联合拟合 key 中心、径向归一化参数与 K/V 向量码本以匹配冻结模型的投影注意力输出，并用参考 next-token 交叉熵损失的平方梯度估计逐通道 Fisher 型敏感度；在线用敏感度加权各 KV 状态的重建误差，在每层每 KV 头预算下保留高分状态为高精度 anchor。

关键数字 每层每 KV 头 56 个额外 FP16 anchor 时，CALFA-KV (d8b8) 在三个模型的七个基准平均分上超过所有 1-bit 基线；d8b10 名义索引率 1.25 bit/通道，与 BF16 差距收窄至 0.90–2.01 分。

为什么值得看 把校准与 Fisher 敏感度 anchor 结合进 1-bit KV 压缩，并给出 anchor 选择相对最优的 excess risk 理论界。

item.title: Bit-level Perceptron Prediction for Indirect Branches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Modern software uses indirect branches for various purposes including, but not limited to, virtual method dispatch and implementation of switch statements. Because an indirect branch's target address cannot be determined prior to execution, high-performance processors depend on highly-accurate indirect branch prediction techniques to mitigate control hazards. This paper proposes a new indirect branch prediction scheme that predicts target addresses at the bit level. Using a series of perceptron-based predictors, our predictor predicts individual branch target address bits based on correlations within branch history. Our evaluations show this new branch target predictor is competitive with state-of-the-art branch target predictors at an equivalent hardware budget. For instance, over a set of workloads including SPEC and mobile applications, our predictor achieves a misprediction rate of 0.183 mispredictions per 1000 instructions, compared with 0.193 for the state-of-the-art ITTAGE predictor and 0.29 for a VPC-based indirect predictor.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Bias, Measurement Error, and Double-Dipping: When Can GNN Convolutions Help Brain Connectome Prediction?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are an important tool for fMRI prediction, where empirical functional connectivity matrices serve both as features and for graph construction. However, recent studies and our own experiments show that these methods often fail to outperform simpler graph-agnostic baselines. We propose a statistical explanation for this failure by formulating connectome prediction as an errors-in-variables (EIV) problem: the true connectome is latent, while the observed covariance matrix is a noisy finite-time-series estimate. In a linear asymptotic setting, we decompose the effect of graph convolution into three mechanisms: smoothing-induced bias and variance reduction, graph estimation error, and a double-dipping effect arising when the same noisy matrix determines both graph and features. Under a latent community model adapted to neuroscience, we identify a narrow favorable regime, set by the brain community structure, the predictive signal, the graph construction and the recording length, in which message passing can improve prediction. Simulations validate this decomposition, while real-data experiments illustrate that connectome GNN pipelines often fall outside this…

item.title: Beyond Host-Side Control: HBM Controller Partitioning Across Host and HBM Base Dies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Recent generations of high bandwidth memory (HBM), such as HBM4, allow the base die of the memory stack to be manufactured using a logic process that can accommodate more complex controller functions next to the DRAM. We present the first systematic quantitative study of function-level controller placement between the host and the HBM4 base die on a silicon interposer. We divide the controller into its main functions and evaluate four placements, from a complete host controller to a complete base die controller, with intermediate placements that move maintenance or scheduling to the base die. We extend Ramulator 2 with HBM4 timing and maintenance, model a die-to-die (D2D) link with timing checks at the DRAM interface, and compose area, energy, and temperature from synthesized controller blocks, modeled storage, and interface data. A provisioned D2D link preserves per-stack bandwidth and adds about twice its one-way delay to unloaded latency. Maintenance moves to the base die with no bandwidth cost and frees host command slots, and the freed share grows with stack height. Replacing the wide interface with a D2D link saves 61% of host shoreline and 16.85 mm2 of host area per stack. T…

item.title: Bayesian Low-Rank Posteriors for Scalable Membership Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether a sample was used during the training of a target model. Strong MIAs rely on reference (or shadow) models to estimate target-conditional score distributions, but training such ensembles is computationally expensive for modern large-scale Vision--Language Models (VLMs). In this work, we propose a scalable alternative that replaces explicit reference-model training with a Bayesian approximation over low-rank adaptation parameters. Specifically, we model uncertainty only within the LoRA subspace and construct a posterior from a single training run, from which we sample a diverse set of \emph{virtual reference models}. We instantiate this approach using Stochastic Weight Averaging Gaussian (SWAG), enabling efficient approximation of target-conditional score distributions at a fraction of the cost of conventional shadow-model ensembles. We evaluate the resulting attack on three downstream-adapted VLMs across two privacy-sensitive visual question answering tasks, namely Document VQA and Medical VQA. To isolate the effect of pretraining knowledge, we additionally introduce a controlled synthetic dataset. Our approach outperforms…

item.title: BRAT: Bounded Residual-Aligned Training for Stable Multi-Pass LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning for large language model post-training often reuses each batch of sampled rollouts for several gradient passes to amortize the cost of generation. Under such multi-pass reuse, existing objectives fail in different ways: unclipped updates collapse as the policy drifts away from the sampling policy, adding a negative baseline avoids collapse but reinforces every sampled response, and PPO-style ratio clipping cuts off gradients abruptly. We first ask why reuse is fragile. Measuring how well an update estimated from a small rollout group aligns with the KL-regularized target on held-out rollouts of the same prompts, we find that this alignment drops by nearly an order of magnitude from in-sample to held-out rollouts across three base models, suggesting that repeated passes largely overfit the sampled group. Motivated by this finding, we propose Bounded Residual-Aligned Training (BRAT), motivated by a proximal update toward a bounded reweighting of the sampling policy. BRAT assigns each token a gradient weight that decreases linearly with its probability ratio and vanishes at a trust-region boundary, and normalizes group-centered rewards by their maximum magnitude…

item.title: AutoC2V: Synthesis-Guided LLM Training for QoR-Optimized C++-to-Verilog Generation
item.description:

item.title: Augur: An Online Learning-based Hardware Data Prefetcher using Reservoir Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Machine-learning-based hardware prefetchers can learn complex access patterns, but practical deployment demands online adaptation, low-latency inference, and modest hardware cost. We present Augur, a hardware delta prefetcher based on next-generation reservoir computing (NGRC) that meets all three requirements. Augur formulates delta prediction as a history-based regression problem. It constructs a fixed-size reservoir from hashed delta features over a short context window and predicts the next delta using a single dot product. The model is updated online via one-step SGD and requires no offline pre-training, no workload-specific tuning, and no floating-point arithmetic. A key technical insight makes this practical: replacing the integer multiplications traditionally used to generate nonlinear reservoir features with bitwise AND operations removes all feature-generation multipliers while preserving the joint context encoded in hash-derived features. Because Augur regresses a continuous delta rather than classifying into a fixed action set, it can predict any delta in [-64, 63]. item.title: AbductionBench: Benchmarking Abductive Reasoning in Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Abductive reasoning is the inference of plausible explanations for observed evidence. Evaluating this capability requires more than a single task: a system may need to generate an explanation, discriminate among competing hypotheses, revise its hypotheses as evidence arrives, or decide what evidence to seek next. Yet these capabilities are typically evaluated through isolated benchmarks with different task formulations and scoring procedures, so claims that a model is ``good at abduction'' may reflect only a narrow aspect of this capability. We introduce AbductionBench, a unified framework whose taxonomy characterizes abductive tasks. We instantiate this framework on 27 datasets spanning ten domains and evaluate eight LLMs from four model families evaluated on single-choice selection tasks. Beyond harmonizing heterogeneous tasks, AbductionBench separates final-answer evaluation from analysis of the observable reasoning traces and interaction histories produced alongside those answers. We analyze written traces as observable model outputs rather than faithful representations of internal computation, characterizing evidence use, hypothesis comparison, uncertainty, contradiction handl…

item.title: AERO: Adaptive Ensemble-Disagreement Routing for Oracle Feedback in Sample-Efficient Online RLHF
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has driven substantial improvements across a wide range of tasks, but the cost of acquiring preference labels remains the dominant bottleneck in the alignment pipeline. While many recent alignment methods improve sample efficiency through active exploration over candidate responses, they typically query the oracle uniformly across contexts, even for contexts where the learned reward estimates are already reliable enough to provide synthetic labels. We propose Adaptive Ensemble-disagreement Routing for Oracle feedback (AERO), a fully online RLHF algorithm built on a Dyna-style model-based RL architecture, in which an ensemble-based Epistemic Reward Model (ERM) serves both as a reward posterior for exploration and as a learned preference-feedback model for synthetic labeling. AERO uses ensemble vote entropy, a Query-by-Committee disagreement measure, combined with an adaptive thresholding mechanism to decide which contexts require oracle feedback and which can instead receive ERM-based synthetic preference labels, concentrating expensive labels where they are most inform…

item.title: ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DSA）的 indexer 需为每个 query 对整个因果前缀打分，长上下文下成为延迟主导——indexer 单独可占长上下文 prefill GPU 时间超 50%，如何加速索引？

方法：提出 ADIndex（Adaptive and Distillation-driven Indexing）：① 层校准策略，适配跨 query 的检索重叠（观察到层间显著异质性）；② 分组蒸馏方案，利用异质性训练自适应层分组 indexer；③ 低延迟推理，query 组内共享 token bank 减少重复全前缀扫描，保留 query 级精修。

关键数字：DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5.1 上 LongBench/LongBench v2/RULER 近无损；256K 上下文下 prefill 与解码 kernel 最高加速 6.22× 与 3.40×；128K 下端到端服务加速 1.54×。

为什么值得看：直击长上下文推理中常被忽视的索引瓶颈，层自适应思路可迁移到其他 token 级稀疏注意力系统。

原文：ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation

item.title: A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

We develop a variational and geometric theory based on statistical physics for the joint evolution of Transformer attention and token representations at fixed model parameters. To this end, we introduce a free energy for the attention and model the evolution of the attention weights by its Fisher--Rao gradient flow. At fixed token representations, we prove that the softmax matrix is the unique free-energy minimiser and that every positive attention trajectory converges to it. For prescribed time-dependent representations, we show that the attention dynamics becomes linear after a change to logit variables. This result yields tracking bounds relative to the instantaneous softmax and sufficient conditions for attention to converge to a fixed matrix. Hamiltonian dynamics for the representations and their momenta are then coupled to the attention relaxation driven by the same energy. This coupling results in an energy-dissipation law. We also develop two alternative Hamiltonians incorporating the attention value map. We prove global well-posedness of the attention flow and all three coupled systems.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for brain-computer interfaces and cognitive state decoding, but progress in machine learning for fNIRS has been limited by small, isolated datasets and inconsistent evaluation protocols. We introduce fNIRSAtlas, the largest open benchmark for fNIRS classification to date, comprising 23 classification tasks from 19 public data collections, spanning diverse experimental paradigms, including motor execution, motor imagery, mental arithmetic, working memory, and emotion recognition. fNIRSAtlas provides a fully automated pipeline from raw data to evaluation and defines standardized benchmark tasks for both cross-subject and within-subject classification, ensuring reproducible comparison of methods. We evaluate a variety of baseline models from fNIRS and related neuroimaging and time-series machine learning literature on the benchmark. Our results demonstrate that performance varies substantially across tasks and that methods validated on limited data -- especially deep learning approaches -- often fail to generalize beyond their original evaluation. fNIRSAtlas serves as an extensible, open, and reproducible benchmark …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Mutual information (MI) estimation is used to probe what neural representations encode, including in protein language models, but variational MI estimators have variance that scales at least exponentially in the true MI. We audit a prior neural-MI study of order-resolved epistasis in ESM-2 on the four-site GB1 landscape. Run-to-run differences show no systematic bias and a magnitude comparable to ordinary cross-seed retraining variability, and the evaluation-pairing scheme shifts scores substantially. At the original dimensionality, two of three alternative estimator families stabilize the estimate across seeds and one does not. In a synthetic calibration at the representation dimensionalities of two other protein language models (a Gaussian channel with known MI; no model representations), all three families recover materially less signal than required, despite correct signal ordering and stable seeds. item.title: What Matters for LLM Persona Simulation: Signal Form in Cold-Start E-Commerce Advertising
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Estimating advertising performance in cold-start settings is challenging because historical logs are unavailable before launch. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential alternative by simulating persona-conditioned user responses, but it remains unclear which design choices actually drive LLM-based persona simulation. Using real Google Ads e-commerce campaign data across five demographic segments, we identify three signal-form dimensions that affect simulation quality: (i) a demographic anchor without noisy rich attributes, (ii) a relative qualitative banner-blindness signal rather than quantitative anchors, and (iii) prompt phrasing. On this campaign, our method attains an MAE of 24.9 and a MAPE of 26.1%, a 51.3% lower MAE than the best tested non-LLM baseline and 77.3% lower than an LLM configuration using explicit CTR anchors. Systematic ablations show that minimal demographic descriptions achieve lower mean error than richer persona configurations, while relative qualitative cues substantially outperform the tested quantitative anchors. We additionally compare these configurations with direct-prior and rule-based baselines and with alternative LLM configurations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Verifier Noise Is a Temperature: Testing Tilt Predictions in Finite-Budget LLM-Guided Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

LLM-guided search loops propose a modified candidate, score it, and keep it if it scores better. When both candidates are re-scored at every comparison, as in the minibatch acceptance gates of prompt optimizers, keep-if-better is a reversible Markov chain if the score difference is logistic and the mutation operator is reversible, and its stationary law is the mutation equilibrium tilted by exp(beta f). For any continuous symmetric noise difference the same tilt is the stationary law of a small-step diffusion limit, with beta = 4F'(0); for a minibatch gate beta grows with the square root of the minibatch size. Caching the incumbent's score instead inflates the recorded score. We test the tilt as a prediction for LLM-guided program search, committing each prediction from calibration data before the search runs. The level after 150 steps rises with the minibatch size in six of seven settings, but its predicted value fails: on bin packing, search attains 62-88% of the predicted gain when the proposer edits the parent and 109-119% when it writes new heuristics. item.title: Update Slope Is Bounded by Prior Calibration: A Structural Bound and Its Contingent Empirical Signature
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Evaluations of LLM forecasters increasingly measure how forecasts improve as richer evidence is supplied. We identify two confounds in this update-slope metric. First, outcome-aware evidence construction substantially inflates measured responsiveness: on the same models and questions, slopes are roughly four times larger than with resolution-blinded evidence ladders. Second, update slope is a change score with a prior-dependent structural ceiling, so raw comparisons can reflect differences in starting calibration rather than updating behavior. The ceiling defines only a feasible region; whether slope and prior calibration are empirically coupled depends on headroom utilization and varies across our Manifold, ForecastBench, and ACLED pools. Despite this variability, conditioning on prior calibration roughly triples the association between intermediate updating and final Brier score under both blinded and outcome-aware construction. Question identity also explains substantially more variance than model identity across the evaluated pools. We recommend building evidence ladders blind to outcomes, conditioning on prior calibration, and reporting headroom-normalized measures alongside r…

item.title: UniExit: A Unified Latency-Aware Early-Exit Runtime for Heterogeneous Edge AI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘应用日益把 CNN 感知与可边缘部署的 Transformer 语言模型结合，但推理延迟随输入难度与运行时硬件状态变化，静态早退策略在动态边缘条件下过时——如何统一且延迟感知地控制？

方法：UniExit：把 CNN 块与 Transformer 层抽象为有序 stage，施加统一的延迟感知路由策略（保留模型特定质量机制）；结合运行时状态感知延迟预测、缓存化预测复用、趋势感知回退与 CNN 特定退出稳定化，做预算感知的 continue-or-exit 决策。

关键数字：在多个边缘与边缘-云平台实现并评估；单工作负载、并发异构与边缘-云场景下均持续改善 deadline 满足率与延迟-准确率权衡（原文未给出统一量化数值）。

为什么值得看：异构边缘 AI 在线自适应早退运行时，兼顾低开销、鲁棒与节能。

发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

方法：UniExit：把 CNN 块与 Transformer 层抽象为有序 stage，施加统一的延迟感知路由策略（保留模型特定质量机制）；结合运行时状态感知延迟预测、缓存化预测复用、趋势感知回退与 CNN 特定退出稳定化，做预算感知的 continue-or-exit 决策。

关键数字：在多个边缘与边缘-云平台实现并评估；单工作负载、并发异构与边缘-云场景下均持续改善 deadline 满足率与延迟-准确率权衡（原文未给出统一量化数值）。

为什么值得看：异构边缘 AI 在线自适应早退运行时，兼顾低开销、鲁棒与节能。

item.title: TwinHash: Two-Sided Object Identity Management for Time- and Energy-Efficient Agentic Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) services interleave large language model (LLM) generation with external tool execution, and increasingly rely on search-based workflows that repeatedly revisit shared reasoning states and computations. These patterns create substantial redundancy across tool outputs, LLM responses, and key-value (KV) prefixes, yet existing serving systems primarily optimize shared prompt prefixes, while naive input-keyed caching is unsafe when identical requests produce different outputs. We present TwinHash, a unified object management architecture that assigns each object an input-side hash key to recognize repeated requests and an output-side content fingerprint to validate and locate stored state, complemented by type-specific reuse guards that preserve correctness and response diversity. A software object identity table maintains reusable objects across requests and trajectories, while a hardware object placement table tracks their residency across hierarchical memory tiers so that evicted state can be retrieved rather than recomputed. Across seven agent frameworks and five benchmark suites, reuse follows workflow structure more than benchmark identity. Twi…

item.title: Transformer-FSQ: Discrete Latents for Extreme KV-Cache Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：本地消费设备上 KV cache 随上下文线性增长、迅速超过模型本身——现有压缩方法在中等压缩比之外失效，如何实现极端 KV cache 压缩？

方法：Transformer-FSQ：用有限标量量化（FSQ）瓶颈替换标准 key/value 投影，每 token 存打包的离散整数码向量、无逐 token 量化元数据；转换预训练模型只需训练这些投影（每原始参数 0.25 token）；融合 Triton kernel 直接从整数码解码。

关键数字：Qwen3-1.7B-Base 保留 20 万条目需 21 GiB（模型权重的 6.6 倍）；RULER 长上下文检索上 12×–97.5× 压缩为评估中最准方法；Qwen3-8B-Base 在 32× 压缩时解码吞吐为原生 SDPA 的 1.01×、97.5× 时 1.54×。

为什么值得看：极端 KV 压缩让固定设备可容纳的上下文大幅延长，端侧个性化模型直接受益。

item.title: Transferring local rib responses to new component geometries in sheet forming with a graph-based Transformer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Sheet metal components often consist of a global geometry, such as the corner radii and forming depth of a corner component, and local features added to it. During forming, both affect material flow. A surrogate learning all their combinations may need large training data. However, the same local feature type is often used on many global geometries. This study therefore partly decouples local features from the global geometry. The local-feature effect is first learned on one global geometry, needing fewer simulations than learning all combinations, then transferred to other global geometries via transfer learning, which can need fewer target simulations than training from scratch. A baseline-conditioned residual surrogate, R-BiLoGo, is proposed for ribs on the side walls of hot-stamped corner components. Its inputs are the baseline response and the geometric perturbation introduced by the ribs. Its outputs are the changes in displacement and thinning from the baseline. R-BiLoGo gave lower errors than a hierarchical graph-based model and a Transolver-based model on the source geometry, and on two of three selected target geometries after transfer. Across the 22 target geometries, tr…

item.title: Towards Sustainable Federated Learning via Carbon-Aware Client Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

The Information/Communication Technology (ICT) industry is severely challenging the global environment due to the sharply rising carbon emissions generated by machine learning (ML) workloads. Federated Learning (FL) is one of the prominent distributed ML systems used in applications with billions of client devices, such as Google Gboard and Apple Siri. Nearly half of the total carbon footprint in FL originates from client-side computation during local training. However, existing client selection strategies in FL primarily focus on minimizing energy consumption rather than carbon emissions, despite the fact that carbon impact depends not only on computational load but also on the underlying carbon intensity of the energy source. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a carbon-aware fair client selection strategy (CA-FCS) designed to minimize the carbon emissions associated with model training on client devices. In contrast to existing approaches for reducing carbon emissions in FL, we incorporate hourly carbon intensity and a realistic energy consumption model developed using empirical measurements from Google Pixel smartphones to estimate client-side carbon emissions in FL…

item.title: Topology as a Design Variable: Joint Architecture-Sizing Optimization for SRAM
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：SRAM 的功耗-性能-面积-稳定性权衡取决于 bitcell topology 这一离散架构选择，且与连续晶体管尺寸不可分离地交互——但开源 SRAM 工具都不把 topology 当作可优化变量。

方法：OpenYieldV2 三项贡献：全参数化编译器生成完整的 6T/10T SRAM 宏（含外围电路与 replica-bitline 自定时，保证同条件下可比）；few-shot TabPFN 代理模型用少量全宏 SPICE 样本学习 topology 相关 PPA 响应；粗到细多目标优化器联合探索离散拓扑选择与连续尺寸微调。

关键数字：实验显示拓扑决策边界随工作条件约束移动而非固定设计规则；跨该边界联合优化相对最强单拓扑基线 hypervolume 最高提升 17.3%。

为什么值得看：SRAM 设计自动化把 topology 提升为一等设计变量的开源工具链。

item.title: The World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA): Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design for Embedded AI in Robotics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 具身 AI 从感知走向预测：机器人用世界模型在压缩潜空间预测候选动作结果，但每一步都须在功耗与散热受限的板载环境完成，其能耗下界与真实硬件差距未被刻画。

方法 从信息论与布尔电路复杂度推导潜状态转移的算术操作数与 CMOS 动态能耗下界；据此提出 WMPA 芯片架构——近存计算、实时熵估计、可变精度 rollout 单元、写时复制潜 scratchpad。

关键数字 DreamerV3 式 RSSM 的 rollout 全部受内存带宽约束，GPU 能耗至少为 CMOS 能耗下界的 5.9×10^10 倍；持续规划把毫米级硅片加热至 556K；WMPA 以 40x 更低功耗为目标，同尺寸硅片模拟温度 306K。

为什么值得看 给出嵌入式世界模型规划的能量下界到瓶颈再到架构的完整推演链，对机器人端侧推理芯片设计有指导意义。

item.title: The Cost of Coverage: Conformalising Native Forecast Uncertainty for GB Wind Power
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Uncertainty bands on wind forecasts help inform reserve sizing and commitments, but often fail to deliver their stated coverage. We apply conformal prediction to native bands to see what it adds and what it costs, comparing six forecasters, from ARIMA to a tabular foundation model, at two wind farms in Great Britain (GB) under operational conditions. We show that calibration repairs empirical marginal coverage with little or no Winkler Score penalty, but this apparent success conceals under-coverage in high winds. Calibrating by forecast wind regime turns marginal coverage into regime-level coverage, cutting day-ahead out-of-band volume in high winds by over 40% relative to pooled calibration while narrowing bands overall.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sparse Predict and Demote: Optimal Scheduling with Minimal Size Advice
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Knowledge of job sizes is crucial for optimizing the mean response time in single-server scheduling. However, predictions of job sizes are typically inexact and may be costly to obtain. Thus, a long-standing research question is: what is the minimal information about job sizes required to obtain near-optimal mean response time? We introduce a novel policy, \emph{Sparse Predict and Demote (SPD)}, and prove that it achieves order-optimal mean response time in heavy traffic while requiring only one-bit job-size predictions for a vanishing fraction of arrivals. SPD achieves heavy-traffic order-optimality even in situations when predictions are (i) inexact up to any fixed multiplicative error bound, and (ii) costly, i.e., the server is used to compute predictions and is thus unavailable to serve jobs while processing prediction queries. Finally, we use numerical experiments to illustrate that SPD maintains near-optimal performance beyond the heavy-traffic regime.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Solver-Free Decision-Focused Learning via Neural Optimization Layers for Edge Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Decision-focused learning trains prediction models to improve downstream decisions, but many methods require costly solver calls or optimal-solution labels. We propose a solver-free decision-focused learning framework for NP-hard edge-selection problems with uncertain parameters in the objective, the constraints, or both. A neural optimization layer is first trained without solution labels, using problem objectives and constraint penalties. Graph-informed edge scoring and iterative refinement encourage concentrated and structurally consistent continuous decisions. The layer is then frozen, and a prediction model is trained through its continuous output using a problem-specific loss evaluated under observed parameters. At deployment, the predictor, optimization layer, and a lightweight decoder produce decisions without solving the original NP-hard problem. Experiments on the asymmetric traveling salesperson and endpoint-free orienteering problems show consistently better decision quality than prediction-focused learning and improvements over most evaluated decision-focused baselines. Our framework requires less training time than the evaluated decision-focused baselines, even when o…

item.title: Semiprime Factorization with Discrete Diffusion and Beam Search: Scaling Laws
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

We demonstrate that transformer architectures trained with discrete denoising diffusion and decoded via guided test-time beam search can learn to recover the prime factors of semiprime integers directly from data. Our approach establishes a new frontier for learning-based semiprime factorization, successfully factoring 68-bit integers-a substantial advance over the prior 56-bit state of the art. While computationally less efficient than classical factoring algorithms, our model requires no domain-specific number-theoretic priors and learns purely from training examples. In practice, the diffusion model acts as a generative prior, identifying promising factor candidates where exact verification or lattice-based post-processing can complete the factorization. Furthermore, we derive empirical scaling laws relating approximation quality to training data volume, model size, and test-time computation. In contrast to language, problem size is the key driver of scaling behavior. Achieving a fixed accuracy on a held-out test set requires compute that scales exponentially with bit length. Consequently, our findings pose no threat to security, as the projected compute cost required to factori…

item.title: Scaling Graph Similarity Learning with Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Graph similarity computation is an important task in graph mining with many real-world applications, such as chemical compound analysis, program dependence comparison, and social network analysis. The problem is computationally challenging: Graph Edit Distance (GED) and Maximum Common Subgraph (MCS), which quantify the distance between graphs and identify their largest shared subgraph, respectively, are NP-hard to compute exactly. To address these computational challenges, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been applied to this problem. However, existing GNN-based approaches have primarily focused on small-scale graph datasets, while scalability to larger scales remains underexplored. In this work, we propose FiLSim, a scalable GNN-based framework, and investigate whether a simplified GNN pipeline can maintain competitive performance on standard benchmarks while scaling to large graphs. We additionally propose a sequential graph-editing strategy to construct large-scale graph datasets with reliable GED labels to evaluate scalability. The proposed framework is evaluated on four benchmark datasets and four newly created large-scale datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness and scalabi…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：现代加速器靠规律性硬件结构复现计算获得高性能，但设计工具常用顺序程序或扁平化模块表达，遮蔽共享模式、导致重复编译——如何让网格规律性贯穿整个编译过程？

方法：提出 SPMW（Single Program, Multiple Connected Work Units）网格化编程模型，把网格规律性作为一等抽象，解耦局部工作单元行为与网格连接、数据投递。Python 前端 + MLIR 编译器，每种 kernel 配置只综合一次供多个硬件实例复用；支持并行编译与函数仿真加速设计迭代。

关键数字：32×32 脉动阵列的 GEMM 延迟相对 AutoSA 降 4.36×，kernel 到 RTL 并行编译快 619×；FFT 延迟比 HP-FFT 低 2.65×；mini-TPU 上并行函数仿真比 Vitis HLS C 仿真快 18.4×；五个编码 agent 用 SPMW 比 SystemVerilog 少用 7.51× token。

为什么值得看：首个在编译全流程保留规律性的加速器编程模型，同时利好硬件设计迭代与 agent 生成。

原文：SPMW: A Grid-Based Programming Model for Scalable Accelerator Design

item.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill 阶段为 prompt 计算模型大部分上层是否必要——能否跳过上层直接填充 KV cache 以缩短 prefill？

方法：RidgeFill：下层精确运行到 split 层，从 split 层状态出发用逐层映射（对校准文本单趟闭式拟合的 ridge regression）预测每个后续层的输入，各后层从该预测写 cache；无训练、不丢 token，给定行、最后几千 token 与每个解码步仍跑完整模型。

关键数字：Qwen3.8-27B（llama.cpp fork、A100）在 16K–120K token 下 TTFT 快 1.25–1.31×，RULER 变化 -1.2/-1.4 点、LongBench v2 -1.4；Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（vLLM）在 9K–32K token 下比精确计算快 1.50–1.60×，RULER needle 任务 99.8 对 100.0。

为什么值得看：免训练给已发布模型加 prefill 加速，兼容 llama.cpp/vLLM 现有推理栈。

item.title: Rethinking MoE Load Balancing as Feedback Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training is often not stationary: the data mixture changes at curriculum boundaries, when a model is continually pretrained into a new domain, or when the corpus is refreshed. Routing is learned against the current mixture, so each such change disrupts the per-expert load the router had converged to, and existing balancing methods have only been evaluated on stationary data. We rethink load balancing as a feedback control problem, in which the deviation of each expert's load from its fair share is the control error and the per-expert routing bias is the control input, and define a family of controllers, the PID-Balancer, from the proportional, integral, and derivative terms of classical PID control. Two widely used methods belong to this family: the auxiliary balancing loss behaves like a proportional controller, and the loss-free bias update is an integral controller acting on the sign of the error. Reading the router as a static map with a one-step delay, we show that the integral term is the only one that both removes persistent imbalance and averages out the step-to-step fluctuation of the measured load, whereas the proportional and derivative terms pas…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Rethinking How to Leverage Cheap Physics for Data-Efficient Neural Operators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Neural operators learn mappings from PDE inputs, such as initial conditions and coefficient fields, to the corresponding solutions. Once trained, they can rapidly predict solutions for new inputs. However, obtaining input-solution pairs for supervised training often requires expensive numerical simulations, whereas PDE inputs and governing equations provide inexpensive physical information. This raises a question: how can cheap physical information reduce the need for labeled solutions? A natural approach is to use physics to select inputs for labeling, but our acquisition experiments show no consistent advantage over random sampling. This observation motivates exploring an alternative: using cheap physics to improve neural operator initialization before supervised training. We propose Physics-Informed Initialization (PI-Init), a simple yet effective method that pretrains neural operators on unlabeled inputs using physics-informed losses and retains the learned parameters for supervised fine-tuning on the labeled dataset. A linearized analysis shows that pretraining can improve downstream prediction accuracy by reducing initialization errors that limited labeled data cannot effecti…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：量化感知训练（QAT）是获得低比特 LLM 的最可靠途径，但 AdamW 为每个权重矩阵保留两个稠密 FP32 状态；低秩内存高效优化器（GaLore、LDAdam）在 QAT 中明显退化——如何保留被投影丢弃的动量残差？

方法：ResQAdam：只保留单个 BF16 momentum，仅对主子空间的 r×r 坐标应用 Adam，对残差施加归一化符号更新（观察到残差仅保留符号仍有用）。

关键数字：两个从零 QAT 方法与三个 QAT 微调流水线（权重量化到 2 bit）上，相对 AdamW 优化器状态内存降低 71–74%，多数设置精度保持接近 AdamW，训练吞吐下降小于 2%。

为什么值得看：QAT 场景下"内存高效优化器精度不崩"的新解，低比特训练直接受益。

item.title: Repeating Work Can Lower Energy per Successful Goal in LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

When a temporary call failure interrupts a tool-using LLM agent, the framework must choose how much completed work to repeat. Repeating less completed work intuitively saves computation, but recovery mechanisms also change subsequent execution and the chance of success. We compare recovery mechanisms by energy per successful goal (EpG), which divides the energy of all task runs (including failed runs) by the number that finish correctly. In controlled vLLM experiments on one node, we measure board energy above idle for eight recovery options on reliably solved multi-turn tasks, with selected comparisons across three model families. For the model tested across all eight options, with the prefix cache retained, starting over has 22 percent lower EpG than continuing after early failures. Under the same cache condition, continuing has 24 percent lower EpG than starting over after late failures. Among all eight recovery options, repeating only the interrupted turn has the lowest observed EpG after early and late tool failures on this model. Holding recovery fixed, retaining the prefix cache reduces prompt tokens needing fresh computation by 86 percent but reduces recovery energy by only…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Reliable Prerequisite-Aware Learning Path Recommendation under Uncertain Knowledge Structures: Long-Horizon Evaluation and Cross-Dataset Validation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Learning-path recommendation often depends on knowledge and prerequisite structures whose reliability is uncertain, while high accuracy in predicting the next resource does not necessarily establish reliable long-horizon path behaviour. This study develops a reliability-oriented prerequisite-aware framework that jointly examines immediate next-resource ranking, uncertain prerequisite structures, hard, soft and hybrid constraint semantics, graph robustness, and autoregressive path generation under course-level confirmatory evaluation and independent cross-dataset validation. Development used 3,187 MOOCCubeX courses, followed by a frozen confirmatory evaluation on 541 held-out courses and 37,747 transitions. The primary MOOCCubeX task is structural and course-prefix-conditioned rather than learner-personalised. Junyi provides independent structure-/hierarchy-aware external validation, uses hierarchy metadata rather than an explicit prerequisite graph and is not a zero-shot transfer setting. On the frozen MOOCCubeX evaluation, XGBoost pairwise was the strongest observed immediate ranker, with mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.9048, whereas the proposed prerequisite-aware graph model ach…
